tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal kyai rdo rje'i mngon par rtogs pa yan lag drug lam dus dang bcas pa'i bsgom don bzhugs so// na mo gu ru he badzra ya/ skyabs gsum ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dang / /sku gsum dbyer med lhag pa'i lha rnams la/ /sgo gsum dwang bas kun nas gus btud de/ /theg gsum mthar thug nyams len bri bar bya/ /'dir bcom ldan 'das dpal kyai rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi mngon par rtogs pa yan lag drug gi rnal 'byor nyams su len pa'i gnad sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod pa'i tshul la gsum ste/ sngon 'gro dang / dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum mo/ /dang po la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis las/ dang po la yang gsum/ skyabs su 'gro ba/ sems bskyed pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas so/ /dang po skyabs su 'gro ba la drug ste/ rten gyi gang zag ngos bzung ba/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i dus/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul/ rgyu gang gis skyabs su 'gro ba/ tshul ji ltar skyabs su 'gro ba/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i dgos pa'o/ /dang po rten gyi gang zag ni gzhung las/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad zhes 'byung bas/ rang dang drin can pha mas gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad yin zhing / de la thog mar bsam pa 'di bzhin du bya ste/ khams gsum 'khor ba gang du gnas kyang / sdug bsngal dang skyon gyi rang bzhin las ma 'das te/ dmyal ba rnams la tsha grang gi sdug bsngal/ yi dwags la bkres skom gyis sdug bsngal/ dud 'gro rnams la srog bcad dang bkol spyugs kyis sdug bsngal/ mi la 'dod pa btsal gyis mi brnyed pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal/ lha ma yin la 'thab rtsod kyis sdug bsngal/ lha la 'chi 'pho ba'i sdug bsngal la sogs pa 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs rags pa gcig bsam pas/ de lta bu'i sdug bsngal can gyi 'khor ba der cis kyang mi skye bar bya'o snyam pa'i blo bskyed la/

de gang la brten nas spong snyam na/ dal 'byor gyi chos bco brgyad dang ldan pa'i mi'i lus la brten nas spong dgos pa la de lta bu'i mi lus kyang cha tsam gcig thob 'dug snyam du bsgom zhing / brten yang yun ring du mi gnas te/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa 'byung bas/ de ma byung gi gong du chos bya dgos/ de yang rang nyid zhi bde don gnyer gyi sgo nas byas pas mi phan te/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad drin can gyi pha ma sha stag yin pas de thams cad 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las bsgral te/ bde ba bla na med pa la 'god dgos pas de'i ched du 'di lta bu'i lam zab mo nyams su blangs te sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya'o snyam pa'i byang chub kyi sems bsgom la/ de'i sgo nas khams gsum snod bcud thams cad rang gi lus la bsdus shing / lus de yang 'byung ba bzhi la brten nas skyes pa yin pas rim pa bzhin bsdus te/ de yang sa chu la/ chu me la/ me rlung la/ rlung rnam par shes pa la/ de snang ba la/ de mched pa la/ mched pa thob pa la/ thob pa 'od gsal la thim zhing / 'od gsal de dbang gi ye shes kyis byin gyis brlabs par bsam pas/ de'i rkyen gyis snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang dang / rang gtso byas bcud kyi sems can thams cad kyai rdo rje'i rnam pa/ skyabs yul rnams kyang kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du bsgom pa'o/ /de rnams kyi sbyang gzhi sbyong byed la 'chi srid kyi sbyang gzhi sbyong byed dang / skye srid kyi sbyang gzhi sbyong byed gnyis las/ dang po la sngar shi ba rnams dang / ma 'ongs pa na 'chi 'gyur gyi bag chags/ da ltar gyi 'chi ba rnams ni sbyang gzhi/ 'byung ba rim gyis bsdu ba nas dbang gi ye shes kyis byin gyi brlabs pa'i bar bsgom pa nas chos kyi skur bsam pa ni sbyong byed/ mthar chos sku thob pa ni sbyangs 'bras yin no/ /gnyis pa la snod kyi 'jig rten chags pa/

bcud kyi sems can skye ba/ de yang sngar chags pa dang skyes pa/ ma 'ongs pa na chags 'gyur dang skye 'gyur/ da ltar gyi snod bcud chags skyes thams cad ni sbyang gzhi/ 'od gsal de nyid dbang gi ye shes kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i rkyen gyis phyi snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang dang / nang rang gi gtso byas bcud kyis sems can rnams kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor du bsgoms pa sbyong byed/ de ltar bsgoms pas gzugs kyi sku thob pa sbyangs 'bras so/ /gnyis pa skyabs su 'gro ba'i dus ni/ nyan thos dang pha rol du phyin pa'i lugs mang du yod kyang / 'dir gzhung las/ dus da nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la ma mchis kyi bar zhes 'byung ba ltar gsang sngags kyi skabs 'dir/ dus da nas bzung ste ji srid bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phangs ma thob kyi bar skyabs su 'gro snyam du byed pa yin/ gsum pa skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul ni/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ge chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma bdud bzhi rtsegs pa'i gdan gyi steng du/ bcom ldan 'das snying po kyai rdo rje yab yum/ 'dab ma rnams la rang rang gi gdan gyi steng du lha mo brgyad gtso bo'i rgyab baitta li'i mdun du za 'og gi gdan la chos pu ti brag ri rtsegs pa lta bu na bza' gdong dar phra bun ne ba dang bcas pa gsal btab/ de yang gzhung las/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i zhes 'byung bas/ skyabs yul thams cad kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor/ gsung rab pu ti dang bcas pa la 'dus par bsgom dgos te/

de yang phyogs bcu ni phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad steng 'og gnyis dang bcas pa'i gnas na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang / dus gsum ni/ sngar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang / ma 'ongs pa na 'byon par 'gyur ba'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang / da ltar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni/ lam bde ba nas 'bras bu bde bar gshegs pas na bde bar gshegs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de nyid kyi sku rnam par snang mdzad/ gsung 'od dpag med/ thugs mi bskyod pa/ yon tan rin chen 'byung ldan/ 'phrin las don yod grub pa ste/ mdor na sangs rgyas thams cad rigs lngar 'dus pa yin zhing / de nyid chos thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/ dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag yin la/ de'ang rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams tha mi dad pa yin pas/ de dbus kyi bcom ldan 'das snying po kyai rdo rje dang gnyis su med par bsgom pa ni bla ma dang sangs rgyas dkon mchog chos ni bka' bstan bcos lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid thams cad gsung rab pu ti'i rnam pa de la 'dus par bsam pa ni chos dkon mchog dge 'dun ni theg pa gsum gyi dge 'dun te/ de yang nyan thos pa rnams gang zag zung bzhi ya brgyad la 'dod kyang / 'dir dge 'dun dge tshul dge slong rnams rang las bslab pa bgres pa yan chod/ theg pa chen po pha rol du phyin pa'i skabs su byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun ni slob pa phyir mi bzlog pa rnams la 'dod kyang / 'dir rang las bslab pa rgan pa'i byang sems kyi sdom ldan khyim pa yan chad yin/ sngags kyi theg par dpe'i ye shes rgyud la skyes pa'i gang zag la 'chad kyang / 'dir sngags sdom rdzogs par thob la ma nyams pa'i rang las bslab pa bgres pa yan chad la byed do/ /de lta bu'i dge 'dun rnams kyang 'khor gyi lha mo rnams la 'dus par bsam pa ni dge 'dun dkon mchog rnams kyi yul yin no/

/bzhi pa skyabs su 'gro ba'i rgyu ni/ 'jigs dad snying rje dang gsum ste/ dang po 'jigs pa la/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi 'jigs pa/ rang don yid byed kyi 'jigs pa/ tha mal snang zhen gyi 'jigs pa/ gya nom lhar zhen gyi 'jigs pa'o/ /dang po 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa la/ spyir 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa dang / bye brag tu tshe 'di bar do skye ba phyi ma'i 'jigs pa/ dang po ni shes par zad/ gnyis pa la tshe 'dir chos bsgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen nad dang gdon la sogs pa tshe'i bar du gcod pa dang / 'chi khar mtshams sbyor ngan pa dang / gnad gcod drag po dang nad ngan pa las bskyab pa'i phyir/ gsum pa bar do'i 'jigs pa ni/ 'jigs pa'i sgra bzhi la sogs pa'i bar do'i 'jigs pa thams cad las bskyab pa'i ched du'o/ /bzhi pa ni skye ba phyi ma mi khom pa'i gnas brgyad la sogs pa'i gnas ngan pa dang / grogs ngan pa dang / dpon ngan pa dang / slob dpon ngan pa dang / bstan bcos ngan pa/ rang brgyud ngan pa la sogs pa mdor na dam pa'i chos kyi 'gal rkyen du 'gro ba thams cad las bskyab pa'i ched du yin/ gnyis pa dad pa la/ 'dod pa'i dad pa/ dwang ba'i dad pa/ yid ches pa'i dad pa'o/ /dang po 'dod pa'i dad pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan mthong nas 'di lta bu thob par byed dgos pa 'dug snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag po'i sgo nas skyabs su 'gro ba'o/ /gnyis pa/ dwang ba'i dad pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan la dad pa ste/ de yang shes bya ji lta ba dang / ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang / sems can thams cad la bu gcig pa ltar brtse ba'i snying rje chen po dang / sems can rnams 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad las bsgrol ba'i nus pa ste/ de lta bu'i yon tan mthong ba'i sgo nas bcos ma ma yin pa'i dad pa skyes pa'i sgo nas skyabs su 'gro ba'o/ /gsum pa yid ches pa'i dad pa ni/ spyir sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i chos rnams la yid ches shing /

khyad par mi dge ba'i las kyis 'khor bar 'khyams nas sdug bsngal myong dgos pa dang / mi dge ba spangs te dge ba bsgrubs na/ mkhyen brtse nus gsum dang ldan pa'i thar pa mya ngan las 'das pa thob par gsung 'dug pas/ de lta bu'i las rgyu 'bras la yid ches shing / dad pas kun nas blangs te sdig spong dge ba bsgrub pa'i sgo nas skyabs su 'gro dgos te/ dkon mchog rin chen rnam pa gsum po de yang rgyu de lta bu las byung bas/ rang yang dkon mchog gsum gyi go 'phangs thob par bya ba'i phyir du skyabs su 'gro ba yin/ gsum pa snying rje ni/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad rang gi pha ma drin can sha stag yin la/ 'di rnams 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal drag la yun ring ba 'di las cis kyang sgrol dgos pa 'dug ste/ de'i nus pa da lta ni bdag la med cing / der ma zad nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams dang / stong 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i rgyal po dang / sar gnas kyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams la yang med la/ 'o na su la yod na dkon mchog rin chen rnam pa gsum la yod pas/ des na sems can rnams sdug bsngal las bsgral nas bde ba bla na med pa la 'god par bya ba'i phyir du skyabs su 'gro ba ste rgyu'o/ /lnga pa ji ltar skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas la ston pa/ chos la lam dngos/ dge 'dun la lam bsgrub pa'i zla grogs zhu ba'i tshul gyis skyabs su 'gro ba ste/ de yang bla ma la skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshe sbyang gzhi ni/ rang gi nyon mongs pa dug gsum la sogs pa nyon mongs pas kun nas blangs te lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas mi dge ba'i las bsags pa thams cad do/ /sbyong byed ni/ bla ma la skyabs su 'gro bas dbang bzhi pa thob par bsam pa'o/ /sbyangs 'bras ni lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag nas/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku thob pa'o/ /sangs rgyas la skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshe/

sbyang gzhi zhe sdang gi kun nas blangs te yid kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad do/ /sbyong byed ni sangs rgyas la skyabs su 'gro bas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob par bsam pa'o/ /sbyangs 'bras ni/ yid kyi dri ma dag nas sangs rgyas dkon mchog gi chos kyi sku thob pa'o/ /chos la skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshe/ sbyang gzhi 'dod chags kyi kun nas blangs te ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad do/ /sbyong byed ni chos la skyabs su 'gro bas gsang ba'i dbang thob par bsam pa'o/ /sbyangs 'bras ni ngag gi dri ma dag nas chos dkon mchog gi longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob pa'o/ /dge 'dun la skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshe/ sbyang gzhi ni gti mug gi kun nas blangs te lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad do/ /sbyong byed dge 'dun dkon mchog la skyabs su 'gro bas bum pa'i dbang thob par bsam pa'o/ /sbyangs 'bras lus kyi dri ma dag ste dge 'dun dkon mchog gi sprul sku'i go 'phangs thob pa ste/ don de rnams yid la dran pa'i sgo nas/ gzhung las/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar ngag tu brjod/ de yang dpal ldan ni tshogs gnyis kyi dpal dang ldan pa'o/ /bla ma ni yon tan gyi khur gyi lci ba'o/ /dam pa ni dbang bskur ba la sogs pa'i sgo nas rang rjes su 'dzin pa'o/ /rnams zhes pa mang tshig de tshig gcig la sogs pa'i dam pa'i chos kyi bka' drin mnos pa'i bla ma thams cad la skyabs su 'gro ba'o/ /rdzogs pa ni spang rtogs kyi yon tan thams cad rdzogs pa'o/ /sangs rgyas pa ni ma rig pa'i gnyid las sangs shing shes bya thams cad la blo gros rgyas pa ste/

ma rig gnyid las sangs phyir dang / /shes bya la ni blo rgyas phyir/ /sangs rgyas padma ltar sangs rgyas/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bcom ldan 'das ni bdud bzhi bcom zhing / dbang phyug gi yon tan drug dang ldan pa yin/ 'das zhes pa lo tsā ba rnams kyi bla btags su byas pa'o/ /rnams ni mang tshig yin pas go sla'o/ /chos la dam pa ni rang la sogs pa'i gdul bya rnams nyon mongs pa'i dri ma sbyangs nas sangs rgyas kyi sar 'khrid par byed nus pa te/ sangs rgyas pa'i chos thams cad yin la/ de las gzhan mu stegs pa'i chos kyis de lta bu mi nus so/ /dge 'dun la 'phags pa ni so so skye bo tha mal pa nas tshogs sbyor rim gyis 'phags pa'o/ /dge 'dun ni dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad 'dun pa'o/ /skyabs su 'gro ba'am song ba ni 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las bskyab pa'i phyir skyabs su 'gro ba'o/ /de lta bu'i skyabs 'gro lan grangs ci rigs byas nas/ bla ma dang zhes pa nas/ bdag gi brgyud byin gyis rlabs tu gsol gyi bar gzhung bzhin brjod pa dang / de'i rkyen gyi dge 'dun dkon mchog gi ngo bo 'khor gyi lha mo rnams 'od zer dkar por zhu nas dpral bar thim pas bum pa'i dbang thob lus kyi dri ma dag nas lus dge 'dun dkon mchog gam sprul pa'i sku'i ngo bor gyur par bsam/ rgyab kyi chos dkon mchog gi ngo bo pu ti'i 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par zhu nas rang gi mgrin par thim pas gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag nas chos dkon mchog gam longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i ngo bor gyur par bsam mo/ /dbus kyi gtso bo de 'od zer sngon po'i rnam par zhu nas rang gi snying gar thim pas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob yid kyi dri ma dag nas sangs rgyas dkon mchog gam chos skur gyur par bsam/ de la brten nas lus kyi nang thams cad 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum gyis mer te gang ba la brten nas rang gi rgyud la bde stong gi ye shes skyes pas dbang bzhi pa thob lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag nas ngo bo nyid kyi sku thob par bsam pa'o/

/de rnams kyi sgo nas skyabs su 'gro ba bstan zin to// ༈ //gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni/ rgyas par na gzhung las/ 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yis/ /sogs tshigs bcad gnyis dang / bsdu na sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du bcom ldan 'das snying po kyai rdo rje'i rim pa gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /de la'ang tshigs bcad dang pos skyabs su 'gro ba mdor bsdus pa'i tshul gyis bstan te/ de yang 'gro rnams zhes pa rkang pa dang pos skyabs su 'gro ba'i rgyu bstan/ tshig rkang gnyis pas yul bstan/ gsum pas dus/ bzhi pas tshul lam ngo bo bstan la de rnams kyi skyabs su 'gro'o/ /tshigs gcad gnyis pas sems bskyed pa bstan pas/ sems bskyed pa de la rgyu ni/ gzhung las/ shes rab snying rje dang bcas pas/ /brtson pas sems can don du bdag /zhes 'byung yang / bsgom dus/ dang por snying rje'i sgo nas bya dgos te/ de la sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis mi bzod par mthong nas de las bsgral bar bya'o snyam pa'i snying rje drag po bsgom pa'o/ /gnyis pa shes rab ni/ shes rab chen pos bltas pas/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal de las bsgrol ba'i nus pa sangs rgyas ma gtogs gzhan su la yang med par shes nas de lta bu'i go 'phang thob par bya'o snyam du bsgom pa'o/ /gsum pa brtson 'grus ni/ de lta bu'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang de yang long yod pos dal la mi thob pas/ brtson 'grus drag po'i sgo nas thob par bya dgos snyam du bsgom dgos te/ de la'ang gnyis/ gus sbyor gyi brtson 'grus me 'bar ba dang / rtag sbyor gyi brtson 'grus chu bo'i rgyun lta bu ste/ de yang dang po ni/ yid gus pa'i sgo nas brtson 'grus drag po me 'bar ba lta bu dang / gnyis pa ni/ brtson 'grus drag po de rgyun mi chad par chu bo'i rgyun bzhin du bsring ba rnams ni rgyu'o/

/de nas sangs rgyas mdun du zhes pa ni rang gi mdun du sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad mngon sum du bzhugs par bsam nas/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed bgyid/ /ces pa ni de rnams la dpang 'dzugs pa'i sgo nas sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du bcom ldan 'das snying po kyai rdo rje'i lam rim pa gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam du dam bca' ba'i tshul gyis sems bskyed pa'o/ /rgyas bsdus gang byed kyang bsam pa 'di rnams ma yengs par byed dgos pa yin/ de rnams kyi sbyang gzhi ni byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa'i 'gal rkyen gyi gtso bo ni/ nyon mongs pa zhe sdang dang phrag dog gnyis yin la/ de yang nyon mongs pa zhe sdang gi sgo nas sems can gyi srog gcod pa dang rdeg pa dang phrag dog gis dge ba 'joms par byed pa dang / tshig ngan pa smra ba la sogs pa mdor na zhe sdang dang phrag dog gi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad yin zhing / de rnams kun gzhi skad cig ma'i steng du bsdus la/ kun gzhi de bde chen ye shes kyi ngo bo byang chub kyi sems su bsgyur nas bsgom pa ni sbyong byed yin la/ sbyangs 'bras ni de ltar bsgoms pa la brten nas bcom ldan 'das kyai rdo rje'i thugs brtse ba chen pos mi 'dor bar don byed pa'i nus pa thob pa'o/ /de rnams kyis sems bskyed pa bstan zin to// ༈ //gsum pa rdo rje sems pa'i bsgom bzlas la/ lha bsgom pa/ sngags bzlas pa/ bshags sdom bya ba'i tshul dang gsum las/ dang po ni rang bcom ldan 'das snying po kyai rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug par gsal ba'i spyi bor padma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du zhes pa nas/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa'i bar gzhung bzhin las/ 'dir rje btsun rin po che'i gsung bzhin du/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog dang /

mi bskyod pa'i cod paṇa can zhes pa brjod pa yin/ zhabs rdo rje'i zhes pa nas mnyam par sbyor ba zhes pa'i bar gzhung bzhin byas la/ de nas gnyis pa sngags bzlas pa la thog mar dmigs pa ni/ yab kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ dkar po 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas pa bsam zhing / de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas/ thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha'i ngo bo yin pa la rnam pa bdud rtsir spyan drangs nas hūm̐ la thim par bsam/ bdud rtsi de yang gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha'i ngo bor bsgom dgos te/ rgyud a bhi dha na las/ khro bo sangs rgyas de bzhin gshegs/ /zhes gsungs pas/ de yang khro bo ni gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba la sogs pa khro bo bcu dang / sangs rgyas ni spyan ma la sogs pa'i lha mo bzhi/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni rigs lnga yin zhing / sems dpa' dang sems ma rnams ni zhar byung gi tshul du bstan pas na de bzhin du bsam dgos pa yin/ de nas ngag tu bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sogs gzhung las 'byung ba bzhin gsol ba btab pas/ hūm̐ de las bdud rtsi skya thol te byung / yab kyi sku thams cad mer gyis gang nas shong ma nus par rdo rje'i bu ga nas yum gyi padmar bab pas sngar nas yum rang la bdud rtsi gnas pa de la yab kyi bdud rtsi thim pa ni dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa 'dres pa'i tshul gyis yum gyi sku lus thams cad gang ste/ yab yum gnyis kyi sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi babs/ rang gi spyi bor nas zhugs smin mtshams yan chad gang / bum pa'i dbang thob lus kyi dri ma dag 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku dngos su thob pa yin snyam du bsgom/ de nas mgrin pa yan chad gang / gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dngos su thob pa yin snyam du bsgom/

de nas snying kha yan chad gang / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag 'bras bu chos kyi sku dngos su thob pa yin snyam du bsam/ de nas rkang mthil yan chad gang / dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku dngos su thob pa yin snyam du bsam la/ de yang phung po lnga ni de bzhin gshegs pa lnga/ 'byung ba lnga ni yab yum lnga/ nang gi skye mched ni byang chub sems dpa'/ phyi'i skye mched ni lha mo/ tshigs chen bcu ni khro bo khro mo'i rang bzhin/ nyon mongs pa lnga ye shes lngar bsgom pa yin te/ a bhi dha na las/ rang gi ngo bo yongs bsgyur ba/ /ces dang / sa paṇa gyis/ nyon mongs ye shes gnas gyur pa/ /bdag nyid chen po khyod kyi mkhyen/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don yin pas lus rtsa sprul pa'i sku/ rtsa yi ge longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ khams bdud rtsi chos kyi sku/ snying po ye shes rlung ngo bo nyid kyi sku ste gnas gyur sku bzhi dang / brten pa rang rig pa gnas gyur shin du rnam par dag pa ngo bo nyid kyi sku ste sku lngar bsgom pa'o/ /gzhung las/ sdig sgrib kyi ngo bo dud khu dang rnag khrag gi rnam par byas nas 'thon par bsam pa ni/ las dang po pa rnams dmigs pa bsgom bsla zhing thun mong gi tshul du bstan pa yin/ gong du bstan pa 'di rnams ni rje btsun sa skya pa rnams kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams pa zab la chun che zhing gces spras su mdzad pa yin/ sdig sgrib de yang gong bzhin sku lnga la sogs par gnas gyur pa'i tshul gyis bsgom dgos pa yin no/ /sa skya pa rnams kyi gsung las/ dri ma sems kyi spyod yul te/ /sems las logs su spang du med/ /ces gsungs pa'i don yin no/ /de la lam byed bzhi'am drug ste/ de yang rang yi dam gyi lhar bsgom pa rnam pa lam byed/ yi dam sku de nyid kyai rdo rje yin snyam du bsgom pa mos pa lam byed/

de yang 'bras dus kyi kyai rdo rje dngos yin snyam du bsgom pa 'bras bu lam byed/ de ltar bsgoms pa la brten nas rang rgyud la tshogs rdzogs shing sgrib pa byang ba'i rten 'brel du 'gyur bas byin rlabs lam byed ste bzhi dang / drug tu byed na/ zhen pas 'jug pa'i lam ni 'bras bu la zhen pa'i dgos lam la 'jug pa'o/ /'brel pas mi bslu ba'i lam ni de ltar zhen zhugs byas pas/ rgyu 'bras kyi dbang gi 'bras bu thob pa la mi bslu ba'o/ /de nas ngag tu/ oṃ shrī badzra he ru ka sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badzra he ru ka te no pa/ tiṣṭha ḍi ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣyo me bha wa/ a nu rakto me bha wa/ su po ṣyo me bha wa/ sarba siddhi me pra yatstsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsittaṃ shrī yaṃ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wan badzra he ru ka ma me muñtsa badzra he ru ko bha wa mahā sa ma ya satwa a hūm̐ phaṭaḥ zhes pa dam bca' du yod zla'o/ /gsum pa bshags sdom bya ba ni/ gzhung las/ bdag ni mi shes zhes pa nas/ rtsa ba nas byang shing dag par byin gyis rlabs du gsol/ zhes pa'i bar brjod/ de la sbyang bya sdig pa'i sgo drug dang / sbyong byed gnyen po'i stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas bshags dgos/ dang po sbyang bya sdig pa'i sgo drug gi dang po dus kyi sgo ni/ tshe thog ma med pa nas da lta la thug gi bar du bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ mi dge ba'i las rang gis byas pa dang / gzhan gyi byed du bcug pa dang / byas pa la rjes su yi rang ba te sbyor ba'i sgo dang / gsum pa bsam pa'i sgo ni/ nyon mongs pa gang rung gi kun nas blangs te bsags pa'i sdig pa'o/ /bzhi pa yul gyi sgo ni/ bla ma dkon mchog gsum dang / phyi snod kyi 'jig rten nang bcud kyi sems can rnams yul du byas nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad do/ /lnga pa ni/ bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba dang / rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba rnams ni ngo bo'i sgo'o/

/drug pa 'byung ba'i sgo ni/ lus ngag yid gsum las byung ba'i sdig sgrib thams cad do/ /de rnams ni sbyang gzhi sdig pa'i sgo drug go /gnyis pa ni/ bla ma zhes pa gzhung las mi 'byung yang 'dir man ngag gi sgo nas brjod pa ni/ bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' dang gnyis su med pa gsal btab te bsgom pa rten gyi stobs dang / bdag gi mi shes pa dang ma gus pa dang / bag med pa dang nyon mongs pa mang ba'i sgo nas rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig las nyams pa'i dbang gi sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur ba de nyid las bla ma mgon po khyed kyi sdug bsngal de nyid las bskyab par mdzad du gsol snyam du rnam par sun 'byin pa'i stobs dang / rigs thams cad kyi gtso bo khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa' rdo rje 'dzin pa khyod kyis bka' las 'das shing dam tshig nyams pa rnams thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi gtso bor gyur pa khyed kyi spyan sngar bshags shing skyabs su mchi bas sdug bsngal de dag mi 'byung bar byin gyi rlabs du gsol snyam du bsgom ste/ da phyin chad srog la babs kyang mi dge ba'i las mi byed snyam du snying nas dam bca' ba ni gnyen po kun du spyod pa'i stobs dang / sku gsung thugs sogs nas mthol lo bshags so zhes pa'i bar brjod dus/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag go snyam du nges shes bsgom pa sor chud pa'i stobs te stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas bshags bsdom bya ba ni sbyong byed/ sbyangs 'bras ni de ltar byas pas sdig sgrib thams cad dag nas rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang thob pa'o/ /de nas rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu nas rang gi spyi bo na mar thim pa'i rkyen gyis sngar rang yi dam gyi lha yin pa de slar gsal 'debs pa rnam pa lam du byed pa de kyai rdo rje yin snyam du bsam pa mos pa lam du byed pa/

de yang 'bras bu'i dus kyi kyai rdo rje dngos rang yin snyam du bsam pa 'bras bu lam du byed pa/ de ltar byas pas rang brgyud la tshogs rdzogs shing sgrib pa byang ba'i rten 'brel du 'gyur pas byin rlabs lam du byed pa ste lam byed bzhi dang / yang 'bras bu de la zhen nas lam la 'jug pa ni/ zhen pas 'jug pa'i lam/ zhugs pa la rten nas rgyu 'bras 'brel ba'i dbang gis nam zhig 'bras bu thob pa la mi bslu bas 'brel pas mi bslu ba'i lam byed de/ lam byed drug tu yang 'gyur ro/ /de'i sbyang gzhi ni rang lus sngar blangs tshad/ ma 'ongs pa na len par 'gyur ba/ da ltar blang pa rnams so/ /sbyong byed ni rdo rje sems dpa' thim pa'i rkyen gyis kyai rdo rje'i skur bsgom pa dang sbyangs 'bras ni de lta bu'i go 'phang thob pa'o/ /de rnams ni rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas te thun mong gi sngon 'gro'o/ /de ltar thun mong gi sngon 'gro gsum byas pa'i dgos pa ni/ skyabs 'gro byas pas so sor thar pa'i nyes pa phra mo thams cad sor chud/ sems bskyed byas pas byang chub sems dpa'i nyes pa phra mo rnams sor chud/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas byas pas rigs 'dzin sngags kyi nyes pa phra mo rnams dag nas/ nyes ltung gi dri ma dag ste lam nyams su blang bas dngos grub myur du thob pa yin te/ slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pas/ sdom gsum cho ga rab tu bstan/ /de ltar sngags pa tshul gnas pas/ /dngos grub la ni dogs med de/ /ston pa sangs rgyas kyis bstod cing / /lha sogs 'jig rten kun gyis bkur/ /ces gsungs so// ༈ //gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro la gsum/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa/ ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa'o/ /dang po la yul dag pa la brten nas tshogs bsags pa dang / ma dag pa la brten nas tshogs bsags pa gnyis las/

dang po la lnga/ spyan drangs ba/ phyag 'tshal ba/ mchod pa 'bul ba/ bdun rnam dag bya ba/ rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rang gi snying khar paṃ dmar ser las byung ba'i padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du raṃ dmar po las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du sems gzung 'dzin gnyis dang bral ba'i ngo bo yi ge hūm̐ sngon po/ ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas pa bsgom ste/ de yang padma 'dab ma brgyad kyi sbyang gzhi ni rnam shes tshogs brgyad/ sbyong byed ni thabs snying rje chen po'i rang bzhin padmar bsgom pa'o/ /sbyangs 'bras ni sprul pa'i sku thob pa'o/ /nyi ma'i sbyang gzhi ni/ sems stong par zhen cing 'dzin pa de nyid/ sbyong byed de ni thabs shes rab stong nyid kyi rang bzhin nyi mar bsgom pa'o/ /sbyangs 'bras ni chos kyi sku thob pa'o/ /hūm̐ gi sbyang gzhi ni rang gi sems kun gzhi'o/ /sbyong byed thabs shes zung 'jug gi hūm̐ du bsgom pa yin la/ sbyangs 'bras ni longs sku thob pa'o/ /hūm̐ de las 'od zer kha dog sna lnga pa 'phros nas lus kyi nang thams cad mer te khengs nas tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sangs te byang zhing dag par bsams la/ 'od zer de rnams kyi rtse mo lcags kyu ltar gug par bsgoms nas rang gi sna bug g.yas nas 'thon te rang bzhin gyi gnas nas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pa can gtso bo'i dbu'i cha la bzhugs pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ 'od zer de rnams tshur 'dus sna bug g.yon nas zhugs/ snying kha'i hūm̐ la thim par bsam la/ de rnams kyi sbyang gzhi ni las rlung nyi khri chig stong drug brgya phyir rgyu ba dang nang du 'jug pa snying gar gnas pa rnams so/ /sbyong byed 'od zer 'phros 'dus bsgom pa de rnams so/

/sbyangs 'bras rdo rje gsum thob pa'o/ /gnyis pa phyag 'tshal ba la/ ting nge 'dzin dang sngags dang phyag rgya gsum dang ldan par bya dgos te/ de yang ting nge 'dzin ni rang kyai rdo rjer gsal ba de nyid kyi zhe dag pa'i sgo nas kyai rdo rje'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal bar bsgom pa'o/ /sngags ni na mo gu ru bhyaḥ zhes pas bla ma mi bskyod par gsal ba dang / na maḥshrī he badzra maṇḍal sa pa ri wa ra bhyaḥ zhes pa dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bo kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor la phyag 'tshal ba'o/ /de yang kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor de la dkon mchog gsum tshang ba ni/ lha mo brgyad po dge 'dun dkon mchog de'i thugs brgyud la mnga' ba'i lung dang kyai rdo rje gsal ba de nyid kyi zhen pa'i sgo nas rtogs pa'i yon tan thams cad chos dkon mchog go /phyag rgya ni snying gar rdo rje thal mo sbyar nas byed dgos te/ rdo rje thal mo de nyid thabs shes zung du 'jug pas so/ /de dag gi sbyang gzhi ni rang gi skye ba snga mar dkon mchog gsum la sogs pa phyag bya bar 'os pa rnams la phyag ma byas shing dbang phyug dang tshangs pa la sogs pa 'jig rten pa'i lha rnams te/ phyag mi rigs pa rnams la btsal ba dang / de bzhin du ma 'ongs pa na 'byung 'gyur/ da ltar byas pa thams cad do/ /sbyong byed sngags phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi sgo nas phyag byas pa'o/ /sbyangs 'bras sku gsum thob pa'o/ /gsum pa mchod pa ni/ nang phyi gsang ba'i mchod pa ste/ dang po nang gi lnga ste/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las gau rī nag mo/ ri dwags te zla ba'i brdas bstan pa'i byang sems dkar pos gang ba'i thod pa bsnams pa/ rlung phyir rgyu ba'i sna la sna bug g.yas nas 'thon te/ dang por bla ma/ de nas gtso bo nas rim pa bzhin mchod/ rlung nang du 'jug pa dang bstun nas snying kha'i hūm̐ la thim pa lha mo thams cad la 'dra/

chom rkun ma bdud las rgyal ba nyi ma ste/ de'i brdas bstan pa'i byang sems dmar pos gang ba'i thod pas gong bzhin mchod/ lha mo betta līs dri chus gang ba'i thod pa/ ghasma rīs dri chen gyis gang ba'i thod pa/ pukka sīs sha chen gyis gang ba ste klad pa yin/ gnyis pa phyi'i mchod pa ni/ ri khrod ma'i ma ro ni/ sngon bskal pa bzang po la rdo rje sems dpa' dang rdo rje snyems ma snyoms par zhugs pa byang chub kyi sems de la longs spyad na/ tshe nyi zla gnas kyi bar du thub/ skra dkar dang gnyer ma mi 'byung / lus ldang ba yangs shing zo mdog bde ba sogs yon tan bsam gyi mi khyab pa dang ldan pas bdud rtsi'i gang ba'i thod pas gong bzhin mchod/ lha mo gdol pa mos cang te'u skye nyag pa'i phyi nang kun du bsgrag pas mchod pa'i yul thams cad la zag med bde ba rgyas pas mchod par bsam/ gsum pa gsang ba'i mchod pa ni/ rdo rje rigs kyi lha mo g.yung mos/ rlung gi mtshams nas lha thams cad la 'khyud pa'i steng ka byas pas thams cad zag med kyi bde ba rgyas par bsgom/ de dag gi sbyang gzhi ni rang gi sems steng na tshe thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dang / khyad par dkor dang sku gsung thugs kyi bslud la sogs pa log pa'i 'tsho ba thams cad ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gyi mchod rdzas su bsgyur te 'bul ba yin/ bzhi pa ni bdun pa rnam dag gi brten gyi stobs ni/ mdun gyis bla ma dang yi dam/ rnam par sun 'byin pa'i stobs ni tshe thog med nas da lta'i bar du bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad la gnong zhing 'gyod pa'i sgo nas bshags pa dang / gnyen po kun du spyod pa'i stobs ni phyin chad srog la bab kyang mi byed do snyam pa dang / sor chud pa'i stobs ni de dag la brten nas sdig pa thams cad dag go snyam du bsgom pa'o/ /'khor 'das kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba che chung thams cad la phrag dog med pa'i sgo nas rjes su yi rang snyam pa dang /

chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs spros bral gyi ngang la cung zad mnyam par bzhag pa dang / sangs rgyas la lam ston pa/ chos la lam dngos/ dge 'dun la lam bsgrub pa'i grogs zhu ba'i tshul gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i dkon mchog gsum la bdag gzhan sems can thams cad skyabs su 'gro ba dang / sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya'o snyam pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i ched du phar phyin drug gam bcus bsdus pa'i rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po che mtha' dag lam rim pa gnyis su bsdus nas nyams su blang snyam pa dang / de lta bu'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad gcig tu sdom pa la brten nas sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par gyur gcig snyam du bsgom pa ste yan lag bdun pa'i don bsam zhing lan gsum rdo rje thal mo sbyar la bya'o/ /lnga pa sdom pa bzung ba la/ yul gang la/ gang zag gang gi dus ji tsam du/ tshul ji ltar sdom pa bzung ba'o/ /dang po yul ni/ rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang / nyon mongs pa'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i dpa' bo dang gnyis med kyi don dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor ma rnams bdag la thugs gtad nas dgongs su gsol/ gnyis pa sdom pa 'dzin pa'i gang zag ni/ rang dngos kyi ming chos ming nas smos pa'o/ /gsum pa sdom pa 'dzin pa'i dus ni/ dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du'o/ /bzhi pa tshul ji ltar sdom pa bzung ba la/ rigs lnga spyi'i sdom pa bzung ba/ so so'i sdom pa bzung ba/ mdor bsdus te dam bca' ba'i tshul gyis sdom pa bzung ba dang gsum/ dang po la smon pa dang 'jug pa'i sems bskyed gnyis/ dang po smon pa sems bskyed ni/ ji ltar dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsgrod pa gcig pa'i lam smon pa byang chub kyi mchog tu bdag gi sems bskyed de sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya'o snyam pa dang /

gnyis pa 'jug pa'i sems bskyed ni de lta bu'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i ched du byang chub sems dpa'i bslab par bya ba thams cad nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims/ dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims dang gsum du bsdus te nyams su blang ba dang / gnyis pa so so'i dam tshig la/ rigs lnga'i dam tshig mdzad pa'i dang po rnam par snang mdzad kyi dam tshig ni/ phyi brda'i dkon mchog gsum gzhan rgyud la grub pa'i sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun gsum yin/ nang don gyi dkon mchog gsum ni rang gi sems nyid spros pa dang bral ba chos sku'i sangs rgyas yin/ yin pa la de ltar du shes pa chos dkon mchog yin/ de ltar du shes pa'i sgo nas nyams su len pa de dge 'dun dkon mchog yin/ de rnams la snying thag pa nas skyabs su 'gro dgos/ gnyis pa mi bskyod pa'i dam tshig ni/ mtshon byed brda'i rdo rje dril bu/ yi dam gyi bris sku dang gsum yang 'dzin/ mtshon bya don gyi rdo rje thabs snying rje chen po dang / dril bu gnas lugs rtogs pa'i thabs shes rab stong pa nyid/ rang lus yi dam du bsgom pa phyag rgya sku'i dam tshig dang / de rnams ston par byed pa'i slob dpon rdo rje 'dzin pa ni/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor tshul bzhin du bsgom pa yin/ gsum pa rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dam tshig ni/ chos kyi sbyin pa/ zang zing gi sbyin pa/ mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pa/ byams pa'i sbyin pa ste sbyin pa rnam pa bzhi nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum du btang dgos pa yin/ bzhi pa 'od dpag med kyi dam tshig tu/ phyi bya spyod/ nang rnal 'byor rgyud/ gsang ba rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud theg pa gsum gyi dam pa'i chos ma lus pa ste rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i chos thams cad 'dzin snyam pa'o/ /lnga pa don yod grub pa'i dam tshig tu sngar gyi blangs pa'i sdom pa'i tshogs ma lus pa thams cad 'dzin pa dang /

dkon mchog mchod pa'i las ci nus su bsgrub pa dang / dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba rnam snang gi dam tshig tu 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de rnam snang sku'i ngo bo tshul khrims rnam par dag pa yin la/ skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin pa dang / sku des thugs dang gsung gi rten byed pa ltar tshul khrims kyi yon tan thams cad kyi rten byed pa dang / rnam snang gi sbyang gzhi las 'bras la rmongs pa'i gti mug de/ dad pa drag pos skyabs su 'gro bas sbyong ba yin/ dam tshig gsum 'dzin pa de mi bskyod pa'i dam tshig du 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod/ mi bskyod pa de thugs kyi ngo bo ting nge 'dzin rnam dag yin la/ dam tshig de gsum ston pa'i slob dpon dang bcas pa 'dzin pa ni/ thugs ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa'o/ /yang mi bskyod pa'i sbyang gzhi rnam g.yeng gi ngo bo gnyen po'i ting nge 'dzin dgos la/ bzhi po de bsgom pa'i nang nas mchog yin pa dang / yang mi bskyod pa'i sbyang gzhi zhe sdang de kun rdzob dang / don dam byang chub sems gnyis kyis sbyong ba yin/ sbyin pa rnam bzhi sbyin pa de/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dam tshig du 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rin chen 'byung ldan de yon tan gyi ngo bo sbyin pa rnam par dag pa yin la/ rin po che las dgos 'dod 'byung ba ltar rin chen 'byung ldan gyis sbyin pa rnam bzhi'i sgo nas sems can gyi re 'dod bskang ste sbyang gzhi ser sna sbyong ba yin no/ /theg pa gsum gyi dam chos 'dzin pa de 'od dpag med pa'i dam tshig tu 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ 'od dpag med gsung gi bzod pa rnam par dag pa yin/ dam pa'i chos rnams ni gsung gi ngo bo yin pa dang / bzod pa'i nang nas chos la nges par sems pa'i bzod pa de gtso bo yin pa dang / des sbyang gzhi 'dod chags sbyong ba yin no/ /sngar khas blangs pa'i dam tshig rnams 'dzin pa dang /

mchod pa'i las ci nus su bsgrub pa don yod grub pa'i dam tshig tu 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ don grub de 'phrin las kyi ngo bo brtson 'grus rnam par dag pa yin la/ sdom pa bsrung ba dang mchod pa la sogs pa brtson 'grus kyi sgo nas byed dgos pa dang / sbyang gzhi las ngan dang phrag dog la sogs pa sdom pa bsrung ba dang / mchod pa la sogs pa'i las bzang po des sbyong ba yin/ gsum pa mdor bsdus nas bsrung ba ni sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po che thams cad lam rim pa gnyis 'khor dang bcas par bsdus te nyams su blangs bar bya'o snyam pa dang de rnams nyams su blang ba la rten nas tshangs pa dang brgya byin sogs 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi ma sgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang / nyan rang sogs shes sgrib kyis 'ching ba las ma grol ba rnams sgrol/ ngan song gsum la sogs pa sdug bsngal gyi dbugs ma dbyung ba rnams dbugs dbyung / mthar sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i myang 'das la 'god snyam pa'i sgo nas lan gsum byas pas tshogs rten rnams kyi zhal nas rigs kyi bu khyod kyis gnas pa 'di la gnas na mchog gi dngos grub thob pa'i skal ba yod pas lam rim pa gnyis sgoms shig ces gsungs par bsam nas tshogs zhing rnams mi dmigs par bsgom/ yul ma dag pa la brten nas tshogs bsags pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ dang por byams pa bsgom par bya/ /gnyis pa snying rje rnams bsgom zhing / /gsum pa dga' ba bsgom pa dang / /kun gyi mthar ni btang snyoms so/ /zhes dang / gur las/ tshangs pa'i gnas ni bzhi po yis/ /sems kyi ngal ni gso bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pas/ bsgom tshul mang du 'dug kyang thun mong ma yin pa'i lugs ni/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang zhes pa'i tshe/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs kha'i hūm̐ las lha mo pukka sī ngo bo 'od zer sngon po dpag med sna bug g.yas nas 'phros/

sems can thams cad kyi sa'i khams sbyangs/ pukka sī'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus sna bug g.yon nas snying kha'i hūm̐ la thim/ de bzhin du sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang zhes pa'i tshe/ gong bzhin snying kha'i hūm̐ las ri khrod ma'i ngo bo 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi chu'i khams sbyangs/ ri khrod ma'i go 'phang la bkod pa sogs gong dang 'dra/ sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang zhes pa'i tshe/ snying kha'i hūm̐ las gdol pa mo'i ngo bo 'od zer sngo la dmar ba'i mdangs can spros sems can thams cad kyi me'i khams sbyangs/ gdol pa mo'i go 'phang la bkod par bya sogs/ nye ring chags sdang dang zhes pa'i tshe/ snying kha'i hūm̐ las g.yung mo'i ngo bo 'od zer ljang gu 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi rlung gi khams sbyangs/ g.yung mo'i go 'phang la bkod pa sogs bzhi ka la 'dra ba yin/ bsod nams kyi tshogs de dag gi sbyang gzhi ni/ 'das ma 'ongs da lta gsum gyi skabs su sdig pa sog pa'i rten sngar rang gi ji snyed blangs pa/ ma 'ongs pa nas len rgyu da ltar len rgyu 'di rnams thams cad tshogs bsog pa'i rten yi dam kyai rdo rje'i rnam pa can 'dir bsgyur ba yin/ dus gsum sdig pa sog pa'i yul bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten nang bcud kyi sems can la brten nas sdig pa bsags pa'i yul thams cad 'dir bla ma dang kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i rnam par bsgyur ba yin/ tshogs bsog pa'i tshul ni lus ngag yid gsum gyi bya ba thams cad phyag dang mchod pa sogs tshogs bsog pa'i tshul rnams su bsgyur ba yin no/ /ye shes kyi tshogs bsag pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ yang ni stong pa byang chub ste/ /zhes dang / gur las/ bden dang rdzun par spyad pa yis/ /rtags pas nye bar mi dgos te/ /skye ba med pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /skye ba 'di ni rab tu brjod/ /oṃ shu n+ya ta sogs gsungs pa'i don la stong nyid la goms 'dris che chung gi dbang gi

stong nyid rim gyi bsgom pa dang cig car du bsgom pa gnyis las/ dang po ni snang ba sems/ sems sgyu ma/ sgyu ma rang bzhin med pa ste/ bdag gzhan snang ba thams cad mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid kyi ngang la blo bzhag ste/ shu n+ya ta brjod/ stong nyid gom 'dris che ba rnams kyi ni/ bdag gzhan snang ba thams cad mi dmigs te stong par bsgom pa dang / sngags kyi byin gyis rlabs pa dus gcig bya ba yin/ sngags don ni/ oṃ me long lta bu'i ye shes/ shu n+ya ta mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ dzñā na so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ badzra bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ swā bhā wa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ atma ko3haṃ ni nga'o zhes pa dang / yang shu n+ya ta ni rtogs bya'i yul rang bzhin rnam dag dzñā na de rtogs byed kyi yul can ye shes/ badzra yul can des yul de gnyis med du rtogs tshul/ swa bhā wa ni yulacan yang rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa/ atma ko3haṃ ni de'i rang bzhin nga'o/ /sbyang gzhi sbyong tshul ni/ sems kun gzhi'i steng na sngar shi tshad/ ma 'ongs pa na 'chi 'gyur thams cad/ snod kyi 'jig rten sngar zhig tshad/ ma 'ongs pa na 'jig 'gyur thams cad/ ye shes tshogs bsags 'od gsal stong pa nyid du bsgyur nas lam byed bzhi bsgom pas 'bras bu chos sku thob pa yin no/ /de ltar bsgom pa'i dgos pa ni/ rje btsun rtse mos/ ye shes tshogs bsag dgos pa yang / /rnam pa bzhi ru shes byas te/ /kun btags pa yi dri ma las/ /dag par bya ba'i dgos pa dang / /gnyis pa thams cad mkhyen pa yis/ /lha yi myu gu bskyed pa dang / /gsum pa bsod nams tshogs bsag ni/ /ye shes tshogs su 'brel phyir dang / /bzhi pa chos kyi sku las ni/ /gzugs sku 'grub par bya phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs so// ༈ //gsum pa bsrung ba'i 'khor lo ni/ ḍoṃ bhi pas/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid du rnam sgom sngon gyi ni/ /rnal 'byor pas ni smon lam rjes su dran par bya/

/zhes gsungs pa ltar kun rtog sbyong byed du de bzhin nyid kyi dag pa'i 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi ngang las rnal 'byor pa rang nyid kyi smon lam dang snying rje'i stobs kyi rjes thob lha so so'i dag par ldang ba'i thog mar bsrung 'khor bsgom dgos pa yin la/ de la bsrung 'khor thun mong ba dang / thun mong ma yin pa bsgom pa/ de ltar bsgom pa'i dgos pa dang gsum mo/ /dang po ni rtsa rgyud las/ re phas nyi ma sngon du rnam bsgom pas/ /nyi der hūm̐ byung sna tshogs rdo rje ste/ /rdo rje de nyid kyi ni rwa ba dang / /gyur cing pa yang rnam par bsgom pa nyid/ /ces dang / gur las/ de rjes bsrung ba'i dam tshig go /ces gsungs pa'i don/ bsrung 'khor gang la spro ba'i gzhi/ de la spros nas bsgom tshul/ de'i sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprad pa'o/ /dang po gang la spro ba'i gzhi ni/ ye shes tshogs bsag chos sku stong pa nyid kyi ngang las yi ge paṃ dmar ser byung / de yongs su gyur pa las sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i steng du yi ge raṃ dmar po yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor te/ de gnyis char rgya shin tu che ba nyi ma'i steng du yi ge hūm̐ mthing kha yongs su gyur pa las sna tshogs rdo rje phyogs bzhir rwa lnga lnga ste nyi shu yod pa'i/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / lte ba gru bzhi mthing nag la kun gzhi'i ngo bo hūm̐ mthing khas mtshan pa/ de nyid kyi rwa rnams kha dog sna tshogs su yod pa dang sna tshogs 'phro ba dang / 'phrin las sna tshogs mdzad pa dang / rwa rnams phyogs bzhir gyes pas na sna tshogs rdo rje'o/ /rwa nyi shu ni 'jigs tshogs la lta ba'i ri bo nyi shu 'joms par mtshon/ gnyis pa de la spros nas bsgom tshul ni/ mang du yod kyang hūm̐ las 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ 'og thams cad rdo rje phra mo nas thang la brdal ba lta bu rgya che dpangs 'thug pa'i sa gzhi dang /

'od zer phyogs mtshams su 'phros pas rdo rje nag po gdengs pa/ 'greng bur gyur pa/ bar mtshams med pa'i rwa ba zlum po rgya che zhing dpangs mtho bas bskor ba/ de'i seng thams cad rdo rje nag po je chung je chung song ba rnams kyi rmig thams cad bkag ste rlung tsam yang mi rgyu ba yin/ 'od zer steng du 'phros pas rwa ba'i nang du gur rwa ba dang dpangs mnyam pa'i nyis sbrags yin/ rwa ba'i dpangs las steng du gur thabs su yod pa'i rtse mor rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa rwa gdengs pa phyed pas tog gis spras pa de'i 'og gi nang du rdo rje'i bla bre gru bzhi gsham bu yang rdo rje'i rang bzhin du yod pa/ steng dang phyogs mtshams thams cad nyis sbrags/ 'og gi dpangs rang gi blo la ji tsam mtshams pa shin tu 'thug pa bsgoms/ gsum pa de dag gi sbyang gzhi ni/ ma dag pa snod kyi 'jig rten snang ba thams cad dang / rang nyid sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad dang / gzhan dam pa'i chos sgrub pa la rang gis bar chad byas pa'i nyes pa thams cad sbyang gzhi sbyong byed chos dbyings ye shes lnga'i ngo bor gyur pa'i bsrung 'khor gyi rnam par bsgyur nas bsgoms pas/ gnas skabs su lam bsgrub pa'i bar chad zhi ba dang / mthar thug sangs rgyas pa'i tshe srod la bdud btul ba'i phan yon 'byung / sbyang gzhi zhib tu dbye na/ phyi'i bar chad gdon lnga/ nang gi bar chad nad lnga/ gsang ba'i bar chad nyon mongs pa lnga la sogs pa sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad bsrung ba'i 'khor lor bsgyur nas sgoms/ de nyid sngags lan gsum gyis brtan par bya'o// ༈ //gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i bsrung 'khor la mang du yod pa las/ gnod pa phyir bzlog gi bsrung 'khor bsgom pa la/ rten bskyed pa/ brten pa lha bskyed pa/ gnad lnga ldan du bsgom pa/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyar ba/ dmod pa 'dor ba'o/ /dang po ni gur las/

bsrung ba'i 'khor lo gzi brjid che/ /bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba ste/ /'khor zhing rab tu mi g.yo ba/ /dpag tshad brgya'i tshad tsam mo/ /zhes dang / bshad rgyud ye shes thig le las/ rdo rje gur gyi nang du ni/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo 'khor bzhin pa/ /rtsibs bcu pa la gser gyi mdog /khro bo bcu dang bcas pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don bsgom tshul ni/ thun mong ba'i bsrung 'khor gyi nang sna tshogs rdo rje'i steng du padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la bhrūṃ yig ser po yongs su gyur pa las/ 'khor lo ser po la rtsibs bcu yod de 'khor lo cha chen gsum du dgos pa'o/ /rtsibs g.yas g.yon la cha re re ste gnyis/ dbus la cha gnyis te gsum mo/ /lte ba dang mu khyud rtsibs kyi bar mu khyud kyis bsdams pas na rtsibs rnams mu khyud steng 'og gnyis las gyes pa'i rtse mo rnams gcig tu 'brel te/ ral gri so gnyis pa lta bu rno ngar dang ldan pa ring po yod pa'i mtshams rnams su byad ma gzugs rid pa/ skra 'dzing pa/ kha nas khrag skyug pa lus thams cad shu ba'i 'geng ste pir ting log pa'i 'og tu me'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i 'og tu rlung gi dkyil 'khor rnams phyogs mtshams brgyad kyi mtshams rnams su re re bsam/ rtsibs dbus ma'i 'og ma sna tshogs rdo rje'i steng gi nyi ma'i steng du zug pa/ rtsibs steng ma nam mkha' la bstan pa khog pa stong pa yangs shing rgya che ba kha dog ser po/ rtsibs thams cad kyi rtsa ba sbubs stong du yod pa'i rtsa ba rnams kyi bar snang gi thad kyi bar snang gi phyogs mtshams brgyad dang dbus dang steng 'og gi bar snang rnams su padma dang nyi ma'i gdan re re/ de nyid mngon rtogs bzhin sngags lan gsum gyis byin gyi brlabs/ shes pa bcu rnam par dag pa'i rtsibs bcu yin/ gnyis pa brten pa lha bskyed pa la/ dam tshig pa bskyed pa/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab pa/ ye shes pa 'jug pa/

dbang bskur te rigs bdag gis rgyas gdab pa'o/ /dang po ni gur las/ hūm̐ ni khro bcu'i sbyor ba yis/ khro bo bcu ni rim pas 'god/ /ces sogs gsungs pa'i don ni/ gdan bcu gcig po'i steng du rang rang gi kha dog dang mthun pa'i hūm̐ bcu gcig bkod par gsungs kyang / bla ma'i man ngag gi gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba bhrūṃ las bskyed par gsungs pa'i don/ bhrūṃ gyi klad bkor ma dang ra ta'i ra gnyis ma ra ces pa gnod byed/ khog pa'i ba la rkyen la sbyin pas ba la te stobs/ ha dang ra la ras ta'i ra la ha ra ste 'phrog pa/ mdor na gnod byed stobs 'phrog pa ste gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba bsgom te/ gnod pa phyir bzlog la bhrūṃ las bskyed pa shin tu sngags so/ /gzhan khro bo bcu rang gi sku mdog dang mthun pa'i hūm̐ bcu las bskyed pa'i sku mdog phyag mtshan/ zhabs kyi bzhugs stabs rgyan cha lugs mngon rtogs ji lta ba bzhin du gsal btab/ bsrung 'khor gyi dngos bstan la gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs pa gsung kyang / bla ma'i man ngag gi mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma sogs skye mched dang / sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/ rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs la/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga'i mchod de stim/῝ yang na sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung bzhin dkar mo ri dwags kyis mchod pas kyang chog dbang lha spyan drangs/ dkar mo ri dwags kyi mchod cing gsol ba btab/ dbang bskur rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab pa rnams mngon rtogs ji lta ba bzhin du bya'o// ༈ //gsum pa gnad lnga ldan du bsgoms pa ni lnga las/ dang po gtso bo go 'pho ba'i gnad ni/ gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba dbus su bsgom pa nyid kyi grub pa yin/ gnyis pa bsrung bya sba ba'i gnad la/ lus sba ba ni rang gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur bar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer grangs med 'phros pas ba spu'i bu ga thams cad ye shes kyi rang bzhin rdo rje sngon po phra mos gtam pas lus bsrung bar bsam/

ngag bsrung ba ni mgrin pa'i gnas kyi rtsa thams cad rdo rje sngon po nas 'bras tsam gyis gtam par bsam/ yid sba ba ni sems ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin rnam pa yi ge hūm̐ sngon po snying kha'i dbus su bsgom pa yin/ gzhan bsrung bya sba ba rnams ni rang gi snying kha'i dbus su rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa de'i lte ba stong pa'i nang du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang sems hūm̐ sngon por yod pa'i g.yas su pha ma/ g.yon du spun zla/ mdun du chung ma bu/ rgyab tu 'khor g.yog rnams ming gi yi ge dang po la thig les brgyan pa/ hūm̐ gi thig le'i dkyil du bla ma srung dgos na mi bskyod pa sprul sku mchog gi rnam pa can pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ padma de'i dbus su mtshan yig dang po thig les brgyan pa/ hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis bla ma'i thugs dang bsrung bya rnams kyi sems bkug ste rang gi ming yig rnams la bstim zhing gzhis nor rdzas rnams hūm̐ gis zhabs kyu'i 'og tu rang rang gi rnam pa can du bsgom pa yin/ gsum pa lha'i rnam pa'i gnad ni/ gtso bo'i hūm̐ zhes brjod pas dbus dang steng 'og gi khro bo gsum zhabs g.yas brkyang du bsgyur/ phyogs mtshams kyi khro bo brgyad zhal phyir gzigs pa yin/ bzhi pa uṣṇi ṣa bzlas pa'i gnad ni/ na maḥs manta buddha naṃ nas/ tsakra warti yan gyi sngags kyi mdun nas nyi ma'i steng du bsrung bya rnams la g.yas skor du bskor bar bsam/ lnga pa 'khor lo 'khor ba'i gnad ni/ de man gyi sngags kyi bar la 'khor lo g.yon du myur bar 'khor ba'i stobs kyis 'khor lo'i rtsibs kyi rtse mos byad ma'i rkang pa nas rim gyis btub pa rnams 'og gi mes bsregs shing rlung gis gtor bas byad ma'i sdig pa thams cad dag par bsam/ hūm̐ bcu'i khro bo bcu gsal btab phaṭa gsum gyi steng 'og dbus gsum gyi khro bo gsal btab/ bzhi pa sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprad pa ni/

rdo rje rtse mo las/ rang sems bdud ces bya bar bshad/ /bgegs kyang rang gi sems yin te/ /zhes dang / gur las/ rnam par rtog pa chen po bsod par byed pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to zhes gsungs pas/ de dag la sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyar na/ rten 'khor lo ma dag pa snod kyi 'jig rten sbyong / brten pa lha dam tshig par bskyed pas bcud kyi sems can skye gnas bzhir skye ba len pa sbyong / sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis rlabs pas de'i phung khams skye mched rnams kyi rgyas par sbyong / ye shes pa bcug bsam pa rdzogs pa sbyong / dbang bskur bas mnga' thang gi bdag por dbang bskur ba sbyong / gnad lnga ldan bsgom pa des/ dgra 'dul zhing gnyen skyong ba sogs bya byed kyi rim pa rnams sbyong / mdor na rang gi sems rgyud kyi steng nas/ tshe thog med nas bsags pa'i las ngan sdig sgrib thams cad dang khyad par du gzhan dge rtsa sgrub pa dang chos byed pa la bar chad byas pa'i las sgrib thams cad bsrung ba'i 'khor lo lha bsgom pa gnad lnga ldan sogs kyi dmigs pa bsgom pa dang sngags bzlas pa sogs kyis sbyong / gzhan yang dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen po khro bo bcu'i rnam par shar ba dang / gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab de nyid bsrung ba'i 'khor lo me dang rlung gi rnam par shar te stong pa dang snying rje gnyis su med pa'i zung 'jug bde ba chen po des/ dam pa'i chos bsgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad dang / sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa rnams byad ma'i rnam par shar ba de stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can/ bde stong gi ye shes su gyur pa yin/ nges don du bar chad kyi bdud spyod byed kyi bdag bar chad rang gi ngo bo dang bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i rim pa rnams thams cad rang sems kyi cho 'khrul yin/ sems kyi ngo bo spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog

sngags rnams ni mngon rtogs su gsal/ lnga pa dmod pa 'dor ba ni/ lag pa gnyis hūm̐ las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rjer bsam/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las gnod byed dgra bgegs rnams bkug sna tshogs rdo rje gnyis kyi bar du gdab pas thal ba rdul phran bzhin du song bar bsam/ rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su bsgral/ khro bo rnams zhal nang du gzigs bsrung ba'i 'khor lo brtan zhing mi 'khor bar bsdad par bsam la/ rakṣa'i sngags lan gsum gyis brtan par bya/ de lta bu'i dgos pa ni/ gnas skabs su bgegs dang bar chad bsrung zhing / mthar thug sangs rgyas pa'i tshe/ srod la bdud kyi sde thul ba'i dgos pa yod// ༈ //gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ yan lag drug bsgom rnal 'byor pas/ /zhes dang / gur las/ sangs rgyas gnas ni rdzogs pa dang / /rnam pa lnga pa bsgom pa dang / /kun du bzang po'i rang bzhin dang / /rang gi lhag pa'i lha bsgrub dang / /dkyil 'khor rnams ni dgod pa dang / /mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba sogs/ /rim pas rjes su bsgom par bya/ /rnal 'byor yan lag drug tu 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar mngon par rtogs pa yan lag drug gi sgo nas nyams su len pa yin te/ 'phags pa rin po ches/ khams drug yul drug dbang po drug /rnam shes drug dang nyon mongs drug /kha dog drug dang rigs drug dang / /phung po dbyings dang bcas pa drug /sbyang na rgyal ba'i rigs drug po/ /thob byed yan lag drug po yi/ /mngon par rtogs pa'i tshul 'di ni/ /zhes gsungs pas sbyang gzhi rnam pa drug tshan du gsungs te/ khams drug ni 'byung ba lnga/ rnam par shes pa'i khams dang drug yul drug ni gzugs sgra sogs drug dbang po drug ni mig la sogs pa drug rnam shes tshogs drug rtsa nyon drug kha dog drug ni dkar ser sogs drug rigs drug ni rigs lnga'i steng du rdo rje sems dpa' dang drug rnams thob pa'i rigs yin/

phung po lnga de rnams kyi chos nyid dang drug rnams sbyang gzhi yin/ de rnams kyang mdor bsdu na phyi snod kyi 'jig rten dang nang bcud kyi sems can gnyis su 'du/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten sbyong byed du gzhal yas khang srung 'khor dur khrod dang bcas pa bsgom/ nang bcud kyi sems can sbyang ba'i don du lha dgu'i skyed chog bsgom pa rnams gtso che ba'i dbang du byas pa yin/ yang dag par na sbyong byed gcig gis sbyang gzhi mtha' dag sbyong ba dang / sbyang gzhi gtso che ba gcig sbyong byed mang pos sbyong ba dang / sbyong byed gcig gis sbyang gzhi gcig sbyong ba sogs mang du shes dgos so/ /de'ang lam byed bzhi'am drug gi sgo nas nyams su len te/ dper na gzugs phung de gzhal yas khang gi rnam par bsgom pa ni rnam pa lam du byed/ de rnam par snang mdzad kyi ngo bor bsgom pa ni mos pa lam du byed/ de yang 'bras bu'i dus kyi rnam par snang mdzad dngos yin snyam du bsgom pa ni 'bras bu lam du byed/ de ltar bsgom pas rang rgyud la tshogs rdzogs shing sgrib pa byang ba'i rten 'brel du 'gyur ba ni byin rlabs lam du byed/ de yang sbyang gzhi rnams la sbyangs 'bras su zhen nas sbyong byed lam bsgom pa 'jug la/ de bsgom pas rgyu 'bras kyi 'brel pas 'bras bu thob par nges te mi bslu ba yin te/ gong du bshad pa 'di rnams sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod pa'i skabs thams cad du sbyor tshul shes dgos so/ /'di lta bu'i sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod tshul ni/ gong 'og thams cad du sbyar dgos rgyu yin/ 'di lta bu'i nyams len 'di rgyud sde'i dgongs pa grub chen birwa pa'i bzhed pa/ dpal sa skya pa'i grub mtha'/ rje btsun bla ma yab sras kyi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log pa nyams len snying po mthar thug yin pas don gyi skal ldan rnams thugs dges pa'i ngang nas nyams su bzhes mdzod/

kyai rdo rje'i rnal 'byor pa gcig gis nyin zhag phrugs gcig la bya ba thams cad rnal 'byor bcur 'dus la/ de thams cad sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod pa gal che ba yin/ gzhal yas khang bskyed pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi yan lag rjes su chags pa rdo rje sems dpa'i yan lag dbang bskur ba mi bskyod pa'i yan lag bdud rtsi myang ba 'od dpag med kyi yan lag mchod pa don yod grub pa'i yan lag bstod pa rin chen 'byung ldan gyi yan lag dang drug yod pa'i dang po la/ gzhi'i yan lag rgyu'i yan lag rkyen gyi yan lag gnas thabs kyi yan lag dang bzhi'o/ /dang po ni rtsa rgyud las/ rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga zhes dang / nam mkha'i khams su bha ga bsam/ /zhes dang / gur las/ chos kyi 'byung gnas rnam par bsgoms/ /de la sangs rgyas gnas dgod bya/ /zhes gsungs pas dang po la/ ming gi rnam grangs/ ming don/ rab dbye/ sa bon/ kha dog dbyibs/ mtshan don/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyar ba'o/ /dang po ni/ chos 'byung bha ga phyag rgya nam mkha'i khams rnams so/ /gnyis pa la ming gi don ni/ bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i chos 'byung ba'i gnas su gyur pas na chos 'byung zhes bya'o/ /gsum pa rab tu dbye ba ni/ stong phyogs kyi dbang du byas na/ zur gnyis pa/ gsum pa/ bzhi pa/ lnga pa/ drug pa rnams so/ /dang po grub chen dpal 'dzin gyis bshad/ phyi ma rnams dza ya se nas bshad/ de yang gsum bzhi la dung ni/ /gru drug par ni shes par bya/ /zhes sogs dang / bzhi pa sa bon ni/ e las bskyed pa grub chen mtsho skyes kyi gsung dang mthun/ lnga pa kha dog ni dkar rkyang dang / dmar rkyang dang / ser rkyang dang / sngon po sogs mang du gsungs kyang / 'dir phyi dkar la nang dmar ba thabs shes zung du 'jug pa yin/ drug pa dbyibs ni/ gtor ma zur gsum mgo mjug ldog pa lta bu mthur du zur gcig bstan pa/ steng du zur gsum bstan pa/ rtsa ba phra zhing gdeng kha che ba ni mos spyod nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar rtogs pa je rgyas la 'gro ba yin/

bdun pa mtshan don ni/ steng gi zur gsum ni sku gsung thugs kyai rdo rje gsum/ 'og gi zur ni snying po kyai rdo rje mtshon/ yang steng gi zur gsum rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum mngon par 'dus ma byas te bzhi mtshon/ brgyad pa sbyang gzhi ni/ skye gnas bzhi ste/ mngal skyes kyi mngal/ sgong skyes kyi sgo nga / drod bsher kyi sa gzhi/ rdzus skyes kyi me tog dang rin po che la sogs pa'i ma dag pa'i snang ba de sbyong byed rnam thar sgo gsum gyi rang bzhin chos 'byung gi rnam par bsgyur nas bsgom pas/ sbyangs 'bras sangs rgyas kyi rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga thob pa yin/ de lta bu'i chos 'byung gi nang du gzhal yas khang la sogs pa bsgom pas gdul bya 'dod chags can rnams rjes su bzung ba dang / chos sku skye ba med pa la skye ba'i rnam 'phrul du bstan pa'i dgos pa yang yod/ gnyis pa rgyu'i yan lag ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ e waṃ ma ya zhes dang / 'khor lo sa dang chu ni sngon/ /ji ltar rigs pa byin za dang / /lha rnams kyi ni rlung chen dang / /zhes dang / gur las/ nam mkha' bem bcas dwangs pa dang / kha dog med dang 'byed byed dang / /zhees pa rnams kyi 'byung bzhi lugs bzlog gi rim pa bstan/ gur las/ nam mkha'i khams ni dbus gnas pa/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor steng du yang / /'od kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /me'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /yang ni chu ni bsgom par bya/ /chu'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas pas/ /brtul bzhugs can gyi dbang chen bsgom/ /zhes gsungs pas/ 'byung bzhi lugs 'byung gi rim pa bstan/ de rnams kyi don bsgom pa'i tshul la/ rje btsun rtse mos/ de nas rgyu yi yan lag ni/ /sa bon bzhi las 'byung ba bzhi/ /kha dog dbyibs la mtshan ma can/ /rlung nas mas rim bsgom par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'byung bzhi re re yang /

sa bon/ ming / kha dog dbyibs/ mtshan ma ste lnga lnga'i sgo nas bsgom/ yang de bzhin nyid kyi dag pa stong pa nyid kyi ngang las rang nyid la ma dag pa'i rlung gi bag chags sems snang dang bcas pa yi ge yaṃ gi rnam par shar bas sa bon/ de la rlung gi dkyil 'khor du shar ba ming / de'i kha dog sngon po/ dbyibs 'od ma'i gzhu lta bu/ mtshan ma ni 'chang bzung dang mchog ma la rlung gi rang bzhin/ yaṃ dang ba dan gyis mtshan pa'o/ /de bzhin du rim pa bzhin sa bon raṃ ming me'i dkyil 'khor kha dog dmar po dbyibs gtor ma zur gsum rtse mo thur du bstan pa lta bu logs gsum la me'i rang bzhin/ raṃ dang zur gsum la 'bar bas mtshan pa'o/ /de'i steng du sa bon baṃ/ ming chu'i dkyil 'khor kha dog dkar po dbyibs zlum po maṇḍal lta bu mtshan ma chu'i rang bzhin/ mtshan ma phyed skas pa bzhis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du sa bon laṃ/ ming sa'i dkyil 'khor kha dog ser po dbyibs gru bzhi yang btsubs dang bcas pa/ mtshan ma laṃ dang zur bzhir rdo rje rtse gsum pa phyed pas mtshan pa/ de dag gi sbyang gzhi ni/ gcig la mtshon na snod kyi 'jig rten chags pa dang / gnas pa dang / 'jig pa dang / bcud kyi sems can skye ba dang / gnas pa dang / 'chi ba la sogs pa rnams 'byung ba bzhi la byed pas sbyang gzhi gtso bo yin te lam du byed pa'i tshul la/ dang po rlung gi dkyil 'khor la sogs pa re re la yang / gong du brjod pa'i snod bcud chags 'jig gnas pa thams cad 'byung ba bzhis byed pas na/ de yang snod kyi 'jig rten dang bcud kyi sems can chags 'jig gi skabs kyi rlung thams cad sa bon yi ge yaṃ gi rnam par bsdus/ de yongs su gyur pa las rnam pa rlung gi dkyil 'khor de ngo bo btang snyoms tshad med dam/ lha mo g.yung mo rlung rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin yin snyam du bsgom/ de yang 'bras dus kyi lha mo g.yung mo dngos yin snyam pa dang /

de ltar bsgom pas tshogs rdzogs shing sgrib pa byang nas byin brlabs lam du byed pa dang / 'bras bu g.yung mo la zhen te lam rlung gi dkyil 'khor la bsgom pa la 'jug pas na zhen pas 'jug pa'i lam de lta bu'i rgyu 'bras kyi 'brel pas nam zhig na btang snyoms tshad med kyi ngo bo/ rlung rnam par dag pa g.yung mo'i go 'phang thob par mi 'da' bas na 'brel pas mi bslu ba'i lam mo/ /de ltar 'byung ba 'og ma gsum dang / lha mo gsum sbyor ba yang de bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa rgyu'i yan lag byin gyis rlobs pa'i tshul ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ 'khor lo zhes dang / gur las/ 'byung bzhi'i bdag nyid dkyil 'khor nyid/ /de'i steng du sangs rgyas bsam/ /spros nas gzhal yas gnas dgod bya/ /zhes dang / rnam par snang mdzad rgyal po che/ /spro ba dang ni bsdu ba'i lus/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi yi ge bskyed/ /de ni sangs rgyas gnas bkod bya/ /zhes pa'i don 'byung bzhi'i steng du bhrūṃ las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu'am/ brgyad pa la bhrūṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de nyid kyi sbyang gzhi gzugs phung gti mug sa'i khams sogs rnam snang gi sbyangs gzhi rnam snang gi ngo bo 'khor lo'i rnam par bsgyur nas bsgom pas rnam snang gi go 'phang thob pa yin/ 'dir 'byung bzhi byin gyi rlobs byed 'khor lo bsgom pa ni gzhal yas khang la rnam snang gi nga rgyal 'jog sla ba'i dgos pa yod/ gsum pa rkyen gyi yan lag ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ ji ltar bsgom pa po 'byung ba'ang / /zhes dang / gur las/ dbang chen dkyil 'khor steng du ni/ /bdag nyid kyang ni bsgom par bya/ /zhes dang / bhrūṃ las 'khor lo'i steng du bdag /srid pa bar ma'i bsam gtan bya/ /zhes dang / mi thub zla bas/ srid pa bar mas bsam byas nas/ /e waṃ nyid du rab tu 'dres/ /zhes gsungs pa rnams kyi don/ 'khor lo'i steng gi nam mkhar rang gi sems kyi steng na dus gsum du 'byung ba dang /

'byung 'gyur gyi bar do'i lus thams cad oṃ dkar po/ ngag thams cad āḥdamar po/ yid thams cad hūm̐ sngon po/ tshe 'dir sred pa dang phyi ma len pa gnyis hoḥdamar po mgo rnams 'thur la bstan pa/ de dag sbyong byed sku gsung thugs gsum/ thabs shes gnyis dang ye shes lnga'i ngo bor bsgyur nas bsgom pas/ sbyangs 'bras kyai rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs thabs shes zung 'jug ye shes lnga rnams thob/ rkyen byed tshul ni yig 'bru de dag las de 'dra ba mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du chad nas/ 'khor lo 'byung bzhi dang bcas pa la 'dres pas gzhal yas khang sgrub par bsgom/ de lta bu bsres pa'i dgos pa yang / 'dir 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor thams cad rang gi sems snang tsam du shes pa dang / de las byung ba'i gzhal yas khang gi rnam pa thams cad kyang ye shes kyi rnam 'phrul du rtogs pa'i ched dang / rnam snang ngo bo gzhal yas khang la nga rgyal 'jog pa'i dus yin te zhes so/ /de nas rkyen gyi yan lag ni/ 'byung bzhir rnam shes bzhugs par bsgom ste/ 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor thams cad kyang rang sems tsam du shes par bya/ zhes gsungs/ bzhi pa gnas thabs kyi yan lag la/ rgyud las gsung tshul dang / ngo bo gtan la dbab pa/ phyi dur khrod bshad pa/ nang gi gdan bshad pa/ de rnams la nga rgyal 'jog tshul lo/ /dang po ni rtsa rgyud las/ ston pas dkyil 'khor 'di skad gsung / /gru bzhi yang dag 'bar ba nyid/ /sgo bzhi gzi brjid chen po ste/ /do shal do shal phyed pas brgyan/ /'phreng ba la sogs rnga yab ldan/ /ka ba brgyad kyis nye bar brgyan/ /zhes dang / 'khor lo ji ltar sngar gsungs pa/ /do shal do shal phyed pas brgyan/ /mtshams bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rdo rje dril bu yang dag brgyan/ /zhes dang / phar ma gcig dang sgo bzhi pa/ /sna tshogs 'od kyi yang dag 'khrugs/ /rta babs bzhi dang yang dag ldan/ /rdo rje bsrad bus rnam par brgyan/

/re kha lnga dang yang dag ldan/ /de nas bum pa brgyad po bris/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa ngo bo bstan la dbab pa la/ 'og gzhi logs dang steng thog dang / /sgo bzhi rta babs lnga yi bsdus/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar lnga yod pa'i dang po la/ 'og la padma nyi ma dang / /sna tshogs rdo rje khor yug go /zhes gsungs pas dang po 'og gzhi padma'i lte ba'i rgyar cha phran drug cu re bzhi dbyibs zlum po kha dog ser po 'dab ma'i grangs la li tas 'bum ldan du bshad/ rngog pa rnams so gnyis par 'dod zer gang bder byas chog zheng cha phran gnyis gnyis kha dog sna tshogs so/ /de'i steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rgya padma'i lte ba dang mnyam pa/ dbyibs zlum po kha dog dmar po/ khyam kha dog sna tshogs su byed pa ni gzhal yas khang gi rgyan sna tshogs pa nyi ma la shar ba'i kha dog sna tshogs pa de mtshon pas sna tshogs byed pa'i sna tshogs kyi mdog yin pas ljang khu byas kyang rung / de'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rje lte ba sngon po gru bzhi pa'i rgyar cha chen bcu gnyis/ dpangs cha chen gcig dpangs de'i dbus nas rwa rnams thon pa'i rtsa ba cha phran gnyis te de nas je sbom song ba'i rtse mo cha phran gnyis gnyis pa/ srid du cha chen gnyis gnyis po rwa'i gyes tshul la a bha yas rwa'i blor yang rwa gzhan no/ /zhes pa ltar g.yas g.yon du rwa gnyis gnyis phyi nang sbrags mar 'thon pa yin cing / kha dog ni sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba sngon po nas chos dbyings ye shes de las gyes pa'i rwa kha dog sna tshogs su yod pas chos dbyings ye shes la ye shes bzhi bzhi yod pa mtshon/ padma dang nyi ma gnyis kyis thabs shes mtshon/ gnyis pa logs kyi rnam bzhag ni/ rgya dpangs mnyam por 'dod pa cha phran lngar 'dod pa yod kyang / 'dir nor bus brgyan pa'i gzhal med khang ston pa'i cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po las/ sa phyogs der rin po che sna bdun bdun gyi khang pa rtsegs pa/

gru bzhi pa ka ba bzhi pa zug pa sgo bzhi gtod pa sogs rgyas par gsungs pa'i don/ lnga gsum dpangs gsum 'dod pa'i don la rgyar cha phran so gnyis yod pa dum bu lngar btang ba'i gsum phyogs gcig tu byas pa la cha phran bcu dgu dang lnga cha dpangs su rtsigs pa'i bsdom ni/ logs la rtsig pa pha gu dang / /drwa phyed mda' yab pu shu'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bshad na/ rtsig pa'i gnas ni/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i dbus nas cha chen bzhi phyogs bzhir bzhag pa'i lnga pa dbus dang por mtha' gnyis btab pa'i nang ma yin la/ kha cig rtsig pa'i rim pa lnga steng 'og tu rtsig par 'dod kyang / rang lugs phyi nang sbrags mar rtsig ste/ de yang nang nas rim pa bzhin nag ljang dmar ser dkar po rnams sbrags mar yod pa'i dpangs cha phran bcu drug pa/ de'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu ser po dpangs cha phran gcig pa'i nang rtsig pa dang mnyam pa/ phyi rtsig pa las cha phran phyed kyi ring ba la/ rin po che sna lnga'i phra tshom byas pa/ de'i bar skabs su rin po che'i bre phul bzhi rtsegs dpangs cha phyed re/ 'og ma'i rgyar cha phran gcig pa steng ma 'og ma las g.yas g.yon du cha phran phyed phyed kyi ring ba/ de'i steng du gser gyi gdung leb dpangs cha phran lnga cha/ rgyab bre phul dang mnyam pa'i phyi ngos su chu srin ma ka ra'i kha nas mu tig gi drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa pha gu'i steng du 'phyang ba ste/ de yang shākya bshes gnyen gyi drwa ba ni/ mu tig gi chun 'phyang ste mchog dbus na yod pa/ drwa ba phyed pa ni mchog mtha' na yod pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa dang mthun no/ /de'i steng du mda' yab ni bya 'dab las spyi blugs mchu med pa mgo thur bstan lta bu'am yu ba dang bcas pa'i rin po che mig gsum pa mgo thur bstan la yu ba cha phran gcig pa bya 'dab la zug pa/ de'i steng du pu shu ni byang chub chen po'i mchod rten khong seng pa lta bu dpangs cha phran gcig pas bskor ba/

gsum pa thog phub pa'i rnam gzhag ni/ phyogs bzhir ka ba gnyis gnyis ste brgyad 'dzugs te/ de nyid gzhal yas khang chen du phyogs kyi cha re re zhing rtsig pa la brten pa'i rdo rje'i ka ba gnyis gnyis yod pa zhes dang / shākya bshes gnyen gyi sgo bzhi'i thad kar ka ba brgyad du 'gyur ro zhes pa ltar yin/ ka ba'i tshad ni shākya bshes gnyen gyi ka ba gnyis gnyis te mtha' gcig ni rdo rje'i thig la brten la/ mtha' gcig ni dkyil 'khor gyi lte ba la brten no/ /zhes gsungs pas dpangs cha chen bzhi yin/ ming don yang rdo rje lta bu'i bsam pas dngos po thams cad sprul pas na ming thams cad rdo rje'i mtshan pa yin/ de phyir rdo rje'i ka ba zhes bya/ des na nang gi lha snam phyogs mdog can/ dpangs cha phran lnga cha'i steng tshangs thig nas g.yas g.yon cha phran lnga lnga byin pa'i sa/ rtsig pa la nye bar sbom du cha phran re re brgyad btsugs la de'i steng du cha phran gnyis kyi gzhu ring du/ de'i steng du dpangs dang zheng cha phran gcig pa'i gdung zlum rdo rjes mtshan pa'i skor ba de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bar ma chad par rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba mtshon/ 'di phyi'i gser gdung gnyis dpangs mnyam pas cha mnyam btang ste thog phub dang po byed/ gdung gi 'og tu rdo rje'i rwa ba yong ste/ 'obs kyi tshul du 'dod pa/ thog thag tu 'dod pa/ drwa ba'i tshul du 'dod pa gsum las/ phyi ma rang lugs yin zhing gdung zlum gyis steng du rtsig zlum phyogs mdog can/ dpangs cha phran phyed dang drug de'i steng du pha gu la cha phran phyed de'i steng du drwa phyed cha phran gcig de'i steng du dpangs cha phran gcig pa'i rdo rje'i thal gdung bzhi'i mig mangs ris su bres pa'i mtha' bskor gyi mig rgya phub gdung gru bzhi pa'i steng du rtsig pa sngon po gru bzhi pa/ dpangs cha phran bzhir lngas mnan pa'i steng du pha gu drwa phyed gser gdung man la cha phran gnyis pa la thog phub ste/

dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje dang nor bu rin po che'i tog gis mdzes par byas pa'o/ /thog 'og ma'i bya 'dab kyi 'og rtsig pa'i phyi 'gram du zheng dang / dpangs cha phran gnyis byas pa'i 'dod snam gyi steng du mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug phyogs re re nas bzhi bzhis mdzes par byas pa rgyan dang ldan pa 'dzum pa'i bzhin la mdzes pa'i mdangs dang ldan pa/ mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas mchod pa byed pa'i tshul gyis 'khod pa'o/ /bzhi pa sgo'i rnam bzhag la/ sgo gcig pa dang / sgo brgyad pa dang / gru bzhir sgo bzhi bshad pa yod kyang 'dir phyi ma bzhin yin pas de la sgo 'byed tshul phyogs gang rung gis rtsa thig dang tshangs thig 'dzoms sa nas g.yas g.yon du cha phran gnyis kyi sa nas rtsig gdong gnyis mi the ba'i cha phran gnyis phyin pa sgo khang yin/ phyir cha phran gnyis phyin pa sgo khyud yin/ de'i thad nas phyogs gang yin pa de la cha phran gsum phyin pa sgo logs yin pa'i sgo gdong gnyis su cha phran brgyad brgyad/ gzhan rnams la cha phran dgu dgu rtsis/ sgo gdong gnyis kyi cha phran brgyad pa'i steng du gdung cha phran phyed pa gcig btang ba'i steng du rtsig pa cha phran phyed pa phyi nang gi rim pa lnga rtsig de rnams kyi thog legs par phub/ sgo logs rnams sgo 'gram g.yas g.yon gyes pa'i mtshams su nyis pral ma'i tshul du dpangs cha chen gcig zheng cha chen gcig pa la/ phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan ma bris pa rnams 'jug lnga pa rta bab ni/ sgo tshad gsum ma gnyis ma gcig ma rnams las 'di phyi ma yin/ de la snam bu bcu gcig ma dang bzhi ma gnyis las/ 'di bzhi ma yin pas/ de la sgo logs rnams kyi phyi rol du cha phran re re bar gdong du bzhag pa'i phyi zur bzhir sbom du cha phran re re dpangs su cha phran lnga lnga yod pa'i ka ba bzhi bzhi btsugs la/ de'i phyi rol du ka ba dang zheng dpangs mnyam pa'i ka rgyan dar dpyangs gi rnam pa can re re yod pa/

ka ba bzhi bzhi mun snam dang bcas pa'i steng du rta bab snam bu bzhi yod pa'i dpangs thams cad cha phran re re/ 'og ma'i srad bu cha chen bzhi pa/ steng ma rnams rim gyi 'og ma las g.yas g.yon du cha phran re res thung ba/ steng ma la cha phran bcu yod pa'i sna g.yas g.yon sgo logs kyi rtsig pa'i phyi thams cad dang mnyam pa/ des na g.yas g.yon rnams la bang rim bzhi pa mdun ngos mnyam por yod pa'i dbus na glang po che'i rgyab/ bar gdong la mu tig gi drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ snam bu rnams kyi kha dog dkar dmar sngo ser bzhi byed pa ni bsam gtan dag pas rta bab nyid ces gsungs pa'i don yin/ snam bu steng ma'i dbus su padma rgyar cha phran gnyis/ dpangs cha phran gcig pa/ de'i steng du chos 'khor zheng cha phran gnyis/ rtsibs bcu'am brgyad pa de'i steng du gdugs rgyar cha chen gcig dang dpangs cha phran phyed pa/ padma'i g.yas g.yon du cha phran re re dor ba'i sar ri dwags kriṣṇa dang ru ru gnyis chos 'khor la mig blta ba/ sgo khang dang thog phub gong ma rnams thams cad la thung du mdzes byed kyi rgyan gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / rnga g.yab dang / zla tshes la sogs pa mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan du mas spras pa/ de dag gi dag bya dag byed ni/ sna tshogs padma thabs/ nyi ma shes rab ste thabs shes zung du 'jug pa yin/ sna tshogs rdo rje rwa nyi shu pa ni 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri bo nyi shu 'joms par mtshon/ rwa bcu gnyis pa ni rten 'brel bcu gnyis rnam par dag pa mtshon/ gzhal yas khang ni rang gi sems nyid rnam par dag pa nyid gzhal yas khang de dang de'i rnam par shar ba yin te/ sems kyi yon tan chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid rtogs pa gru bzhi/ rnam par thar pa bzhi ni sgo bzhi/ yang dag par spong ba bzhi ni rta bab bzhi/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi ni sgo khyud bzhi/ dbang po lnga dang stobs lnga ni rtsig pa rim pa lnga/

dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi ni kha khyer bzhi/ 'phags lam yan lag brgyad ni ka ba brgyad/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun ni drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa dang me tog gi phreng ba la sogs pa gzhal yas khang gi rgyan rnams so/ /gzhan yang dmyal ba tsha grang gi gnas/ yi dwags kyi grong khyer ser skya la sogs pa dang / dud 'gro'i gling bar gyi mun pa la sogs pa dang / mi'i gling bzhi gling phran/ lha min gyi ri rab kyi khong seng / gzugs khams gnas rigs bcu bdun la sogs pa 'khor ba ma dag pa'i gnas thams cad ngo bo byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun/ rnam pa gzhal yas khang gi rnam par sgyur nas bsgom/ sgra don/ gang du sgom pa'i gnas/ sgra don der bsgom pa'i tshul/ sgom pa'i dgos pa'o/ /dang po ni rtsa rgyud las/ dur khrod du ni mgon po rol/ /dbugs rgyu zhes bya'i rigs pa 'dis/ /dur khrod zhes ni mngon par mdzod/ /zhes dang / sam ṭi las/ rdul bral gnas la rtsu ta gnas/ /uryan a ṣo ka ni gnas/ /kong ka ṇa ru zla ba'i snying / /aṣṭa ha sar ka la pa/ /ka ṇa dza tsa gnas ri tra/ /lha mo'i mkhar du bha tra gnas/ /dza ya dha ras gser shing gnas/ /zhes tshig rkang brgyad kyis rim pa bzhin du bstan no/ /gnyis pa sgra don ni/ shwa ta ti shwa sa na ro/ pa ti gnas te gnas so/ /gnas pa'i tshul ro'i byed tshul spyod lam bzhi byed de/ ro mgo med kyi chags pa dang / dpyangs pas langs pa dang / 'gyel bas nyal ba dang / gsal shing la bskyod pa'i 'dug pa'i bya rnams byed do/ /dur khrod ni ji tsam nas byung na rtsod dus mgo zug pa'i tshe mi rnams mig ser byas te/ phan tshun gsad pa'i ro rnams phyogs mtshams brgyad du bskyal ba rnams bya khyi rnams kyi rma byas pa'i rlangs pa nam mkha' la song bas sprin brgyad chags/ de dag las char babs pas mtsho brgyad chags/ de dag la gnas pa'i klu chen brgyad chags/ de dag gi bsher las skyes pa'i shing brgyad/

de dag gi rtsa ba la gnas pa'i phyogs skyong brgyad/ yal ga la gnas pa'i zhing skyong brgyad/ spyod pa la rgyu ba'i grub chen brgyad/ de dag gis me btang bas me brgyad/ de dag gis sems can gyi don du bzhengs pa'i mchod rten brgyad/ gzhan yang gnas de nyid du 'dre dang srin po dang gnod sbyin dang sha za dang 'byung po dang smyo byed dang brjed byed dang mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa bsam gyi mi khyab pa gnas so/ /zhes slob dpon rnal 'byor pa'i dur khrod kyi rtogs pa las byung ngo / /spyir 'dzam bu'i gling na mkha' 'gro stong phrag bdun bcu rtsa gnyis bzhugs pa'i yul stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis yod la/ de yul sum cu rtsa gnyis su 'dus/ de nyi shu rtsa bzhir 'dus/ de bcu gnyis su 'dus/ de brgyad du 'dus pa ni dur khrod brgyad de/ shar du gtum drag la sogs pa rnams yin la/ de dag gi tshig rigs rnams mngon rtogs ji lta ba bzhin du bya/ gsum pa gang du bsgom pa'i gnas ni/ bsrung 'khor gyi phyi rol du bsgom pa dang / bsrung 'khor thun mong ba'i nang thun mong ma yin pa'i phyi ru bsgom pa dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i nang chos 'byung gi phyi ru bsgom pa dang / chos 'byung gi nang gzhal yas khang gi phyi ru bsgom pa rnams las/ da lan phyi ma 'di bzhin bsgom pa yin/ bzhi pa bsgom tshul ni/ mngon rtogs yan lag bzhi'i don rnams drug pa ru tshig rigs bde ru btang ba yin pas/ drug pa ji lta ba bzhin du bsgoms pa yin te/ bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i le'u bco brgyad pa nas gsungs pas shin du yid ches byin rlabs che ba yin no/ /lnga pa bsgom pa'i dgos pa ni/ lus dang srid pa yongs su sbyong ba'i dgos pa/ lha dang 'byung po dbang du sdud pa'i dgos pa/ gtor mgron gyi gnas nges par bya ba'i dgos pa/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum bsres nas nyams su len pa'i dgos pa yod pa yin te/

dur khrod ni sbyang gzhi 'khor ba'i gnas tshul rtogs pa'i ched du yin la/ gzhal yas khang ni sbyong byed kyi lam byang phyogs so bdun bstan pa'i ched du yin cing / lha dgu ni sbyangs 'bras ye shes lnga dang tshad med bzhi la sogs pa mtshon pa'i phyir du yin/ dag bya dag byed ngo sprod tshul ni/ dag bya phyi nang gnyis kyi dang po ni/ phyogs bzhi mtshams bzhi brgyad phyi rol gyi dur khrod brgyad du snang ba/ nang lus kyi sna bug gnyis gcig tu byas pa'i bu ga brgyad dur khrod brgyad/ de la zug pa'i rtsa brgyad shing brgyad/ de nas rgyu ba'i rnam shes brgyad phyogs skyong brgyad/ de'i zhon pa rlung brgyad zhing skyong brgyad/ de dag 'byung ba lnga dang ldan pas/ ri dang me dang / chu dang sprin dang / mchod rten la sogs pa dur khrod brgyad brgyad na tshang ba yin/ dag bya phyi nang gi dur khrod brgyad po dag par byed pa ni/ gzhal yas khang gi 'khor gyi dur khrod brgyad de/ ma dag pa'i snang ba dang cha 'dra yang ma dag pa dngos ma yin te ye shes kyi snang ba yin pas so/ /'di dag gi sbyang gzhi rnyed ma rnyed/ bde mi bde/ snyan mi snyan/ bstod pa dang smad pa dang / 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad sbyong ba yin/ gzhan yang dur khrod brgyad sangs rgyas kyi bzhugs gnas brgyad rnam par dag chu brgyad thugs rje chen po rnam par dag shing brgyad byang chub kyi shing rnam par dag sprin brgyad byang chub kyi sems rnam par dag me brgyad sangs rgyas kyi ye shes rnam par dag chu brgyad thugs rje chen po rnam par dag /phyogs skyong brgyad sangs rgyas rab bdun/ rje btsun byams pa dang brgyad/ zhing skyong brgyad rnams nyan thos brgyad rnam par dag pa'o/ /bzhi pa nang gi rnam gzhag ni/ 'dir phar ma gcig pa'i lugs te/ mtho dman med pa'i lha snam phyogs mdog can/ cha phran lnga cha yod pa/ dbus sngo ba'i dbus su yu ba cha phran gcig pa'i sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa/

rdo rje'i rwa ba'i nang khebs pa/ padma'i kha dog ni mi 'dra ba mang po gsungs kyang / sdom 'byung las/ phyogs bzhi dmar la me rlung ser/ /dbang ldan sngo la bden bral ljang / /zhes pa'am/ yang lha mo'i kha dog dang mthun pa'am/ phyogs phyogs mdog dang mtshams mdzes mtshon rnams gang mos bya/ padma'i lte ba'i dbus su nyi ma/ 'dab ma brgyad kyi steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khorare re/ gtso bo'i gdan ni rtsa rgyud las/ nyi mar bzhugs shing zhes dang / bdud bzhi mnyam par mnan pa nyid/ /ces pas bstan/ de yang nyi ma'i steng du/ phung po'i/ lha'i bu'i/ 'chi bdag gi nyon mongs pa'i bdud bzhi'i ngo bo gzugs khams kyi tshangs pa ser po/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin dkar po/ nye dbang ni gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi bdud sdig can sngon po/ drag po ni dbang phyug chen po nag po rnams gdong gyen du phyogs pa/ thal mo sbyar ba/ lha mo rnams kyi gdan rtsa rgyud las/ tshangs pa dbang po nye dbang drag /gshin rje dang ni nor bdag nyid/ /bden bral dang ni thag bzang ris/ /gau rī la sogs pa'i gdan/ /zhes gsungs pas/ de dag kyang 'dod khams kyi tshangs pa/ shar phyogs kyi dbang po/ khyab 'jug dbang ldan gyi drag po/ lho phyogs kyi gshin rje/ lho nub kyi srin po/ lha min gyi dbang po thag bzang ris te brgyad/ 'dab ma brgyad kyi gdan gyi steng du rim pa bzhin 'god/ gtso bo'i gdan du bdud bzhi gding ba ni bdud bzhi bcom pa mtshon/ 'khor rnams dregs pa can brgyad mnan pa ni/ rje btsun rtse mos/ gdan brgyad bsgom pa bdud bzhi dang / /'byung bzhi rnam rtog spangs rtags yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /sbyang gzhi sa khams/ gzugs phung / mig dbang / mig gi rnam shes/ gti mug snod kyi 'jig rten bag chags sems snang dang bcas pa/ sbyong byed gzhal yas khang gis rnam par bsgyur nas bsgom pas/ sbyangs 'bras rnam snang gi ngo bo gzhal yas khang thob pa yin la/
