de yang 'khor 'das bsres nas lam byed bzhis nyams su len pa yin/ nga rgyal bsgom pa'i sngags brjod par bya ste/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad/ nī la ya pho brang / badzra rdo rje/ swā bhā wa rang bzhin/ atma ko3 bdag a haṃ nga'o/ /gzhal yas khang bskyed pa 'di rnam snang gi yan lag tu 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rnam snang de sku'i ngo bo yin pas rten yin la/ gzhal yas khang de bzhin gshegs pa'i bzhugs gnas yin pas so/ /de lta bu'i gzhal yas khang gsal thebs pa dang / gzhal yas khang gi rnam pa de nyid ngo bo de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad dngos yin snyam/ nga rgyal 'dzin pa'i sngags brjod do// ༈ //gnyis pa rjes su chags pa'i yan lag ni/ gur las/ rnam pa lnga po bsgom par bya/ /dang por skyes bu bsam de nas/ /mkha' 'gro ma yin 'khor lo spro/ /dri za mnyam par bzhugs nas ni/ /khu ba rjes su dran par bya/ /mtshams kyi lha mos bskul bar bya/ /'khor lo'i brten pa bskul nas ni/ /mig la sogs pa gti mug sogs/ /rdo rje gsum ni gnas gsum 'god/ /phyi nas rjes chags rdo rje ste/ /ye shes rnam par gzhug pa yang / /zhes gsungs pa'i don bshad pa la/ dam tshig pa bskyed pa/ sems dpa' sum rtsegs bsgom pa/ snod bcud sbyang ba/ mig sogs byin gyis rlabs pa/ ye shes pa gzhug pa'o/ /dang po la mngon byang lnga las/ rgyu rdo rje 'chang bskyed pa/ bskyed nas 'khor gyi lha mo spro ba/ rgyu rdo rje 'chang thig ler zhu ba/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa bzhengs pa/ de gsal btab pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ mkhas pas cho ga gsungs pa yis/ /rnam pa lnga po bsgom pa nyid/ /ces gsungs pa'i don la/ dang po mngon byang lnga las rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa bskyed pa la/ mngon byang gi don nyams su len tshul ni/ mngon byang dang po'i sbyang gzhi ni/ gzugs phung / sa khams/ tha mal pa'i lus/ kun gzhi rnam shes/

dri chen nyon mongs pa gti mug mngal skyes kyi pha'i byang sems/ sgong skyes kyi pha/ drod bsher skyes kyi gsher/ rdzus skyes kyi stong pa rnams/ mtshan so gnyis kyi ngo bo a li phrag gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rnams zla bar bsgom pa rnam pa lam byed/ ngo bo me long lta bu'i ye shes su bsgom pa mos pa lam byed/ de 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi me long lta bu'i ye shes dngos yin snyam du bsgom pa 'bras bu lam byed/ de ltar bsgoms pas rang rgyud la tshogs rdzogs shing sgrib pa dag pa'i rten 'brel du 'gyur bas byin rlabs lam byed/ sbyang gzhi de dag rnam pa zla ba dang me long lta bu'i ye shes su zhen nas bsgom pa la 'jug pas zhen pas 'jug pa'i lam/ lam de bzhin bsgom pas rgyu 'bras kyi 'brel pas dbang gi 'bras bu me long lta bu'i ye shes thob pa la mi bslu bas na 'brel pas mi bslu ba'i lam yin/ lam byed 'di rnams nyams len thams cad la mkhyen dgos pa yin/ mngon byang gnyis pa'i sbyang gzhi tshor ba'i phung po/ nam mkha'i khams/ skyon/ nyon mongs pa can gyi yid/ rakta/ nga rgyal dang ser sna/ mngal skyes kyi ma'i rakta/ sgong skyes kyi ma/ drod gsher skyes kyi drod/ rdzus skyes kyi gsal ba rnams dpe byad bzang po brgyad bcu'i rang bzhin kā li phrag gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ sbyong byed mnyam nyid kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo/ rnam pa nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa sogs gong bzhin no/ /mngon bya gsum pa'i sbyang gzhi 'du shes kyi phung po/ me'i khams/ ngag yid kyi rnam shes/ nyon mongs pa 'dod chags/ khams dkar po skye gnas bzhi'i bar dor skye 'gyur thams cad rnam pa yab yum gnyis kyi sa bon las phyag mtshan sa bon gyis mtshan pa/ sor rtog ye shes su bsgyur nas bsgoms pa sogs gong bzhin no/ /mngon byang bzhi'i sbyang gzhi 'du byed kyi phung po rlung gi khams/

las ngan sgo lnga'i rnam shes nyon mongs pa phrag dog sha chen gyi dwangs ma/ skye gnas bzhi'i bar srid/ mngal sgong gi pha ma'i khu khrag dang 'dres pa/ rdzus skyes kyi gsal stong dang 'dres pa'i char snang ba'i sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa rnams sbyong byed bya grub ye shes kyi ngo bo/ nyi zla phyag mtshan sogs 'dres pa'i rnam par bsgyur nas bsgoms pa sogs gong bzhin/ mngon byang lnga pa'i sbyang gzhi/ rnam shes kyi phung po chu'i khams/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad kyi chos nyid du snang ba/ nyon mongs pa zhe sdang / dri chu/ skye gnas bzhi la brten pa'i lus grub pa rnams sbyong byed chos dbyings ye shes kyi ngo bo/ rnam pa rgyu rdo rje 'chang gi rnam par bsgyur nas bsgom/ gzhan yang lus sems gnyis kyi steng na yod cing khams gsum 'khor bar 'phen rdzogs byed pa'i las sgrib thams cad rang gi lus sems gnyis su bsdus/ de'ang sems su bsdus/ de dbang gi ye shes su byin gyi brlab pa'i ye shes de mngon byang lnga la sogs par bsgyur nas lam byed bzhis nyams su len pa yin/ sbyang gzhi de rnams sbyong byed de rnams kyi sbyong tshul de lta bu byas kyang / sbyangs 'bras de rnams thob pa mi 'thad dam snyam na 'thad de/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed de rnams sbyangs 'bras rnams kyi rigs sam rgyu yin phyir ro/ /'o na 'khor bar 'khyams pa mi rigs te/ sbyang gzhi rnams dang po nas rang grub du yod pas so snyam na/ de thabs kyi ma zin na 'khor bar 'khyams mod kyi thabs khyad par can gyis zin phyir grol bar 'thad do/ /thabs khyad par can gyis zin yang / ma dag pa'i phung po las myong las grub pa 'di dag sangs rgyas kyi sku ye shes dang bcas par ga la 'gyur snyam na/ snang ba ltar rang bzhin gyi grub na bden mod kyi/ 'dir gzhi lam 'bras bu thams cad dag pa gsum gyi bdag nyid yin phyir grol bar 'thad do/

/dag pa gsum ni/ rgyu'i rang bzhin rnam par dag thabs rgyud rgyu rgyud kyi steng na yod pa'i dri ma sbyong nus pa'i phyir rnam dag go /'bras rgyud ni dag pa gnyis ldan pa'i phyir rnam dag go /'o na nyon mongs pa la sogs pa sbyang gzhi 'di rnams spong ngam mi spong / dang po ltar na lam du byed pa dang 'gal/ phyi ma ltar na dri ma sbyang ba'i phyir lam bsgom pa dgos med du 'gyur snyam na/ nyon mongs pa rnams lam du bsgyur tshul gyis spong ba yin gyi/ sems logs su spong ba ma yin/ dper na 'dod chags rang rgyud pa de rnam pa phyag mtshan dang / ngo bo so sor rtog pa'i ye shes su bsgom pas/ sor rtog ye shes su gnas 'gyur ba yin/ dper na gser 'gyur gyi rtsis lcags nag po gser du bsgyur ba bzhin no/ /de lta bu'i rgyu rdo rje 'chang de zla ba ltar dkar ba/ nor bu ltar 'od 'phro ba/ chu shel ltar dwang ba ste/ rtsa rgyud las/ zla ba chu shel nor bu'i 'od/ /ces gsungs pa'i don dbyings rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag cing / spang bya glo bur gyi dri ma rnam par dag pas na sku mdog dkar po yin te/ gzhan zhal phyag sogs 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa dang 'dra ba yin no// ༈ //gnyis pa 'khor gyi lha mo spro ba la rjes gsal btab pa dang gsum/ dang po la lha'i 'du shes/ sngags kyi 'du shes/ chos kyi 'du shes/ de gsum bsgom pa'i dgos pa'o/ /dang po ni rang gi rgyu rdo rje 'chang dang rig ma bdag med mar nga rgyal brtan pa dang rnam pa gsal bar bsgom pa yin la/ de sbyang gzhi tha mal pa'i 'dod chags skyes pa'i yul du gyur pa'i skyes pa bud med du snang ba de/ sbyong byed chos dbyings ye shes kyi ngo bo rgyu rdo rje 'chang yab yum gyi rnam par bsgyur nas sgom pa yin/ gnyis pa sngags kyi 'du shes ni/ yum gyi mkha' a las padma 'dab ma brgyad pa ze'u 'bru la as mtshan pa/

yab kyi gsang gnas hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ yum gyi padma chags par brgyud pa'i ma gos pa'i padma sems can la rjes su chags pas dmar po tshad med bzhi dang bsdu dngos bzhi mtshon pas 'dab ma brgyad/ yum rang bzhin gyi skye med mtshon pas ze'u 'bru la as mtshan pa de nyid sngags kyi sgo nas byin gyis rlobs/ yab kyi gsang gnas stong pa'i ngang las sa bon hūm̐ las tha mal gyi rnam rtog mi phyed pas rdo rje/ 'gyur ba med pas sngon po/ ye shes lnga dang ldan pas rtse lnga pa/ yul can ye shes mtshon pas lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de nyid kyi sngags oṃ padma su kha sogs kyi byin gyis rlobs/ de yang sbyang gzhi rang nyid la pho mo'i mtshan mar snang ba'i sems snang ci yod thams cad sbyong byed ye shes kyi ngo bo rdo rje dang padma'i rnam par bsgyur nas bsgom pa yin/ gsum pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs nas lha mo dbyung nas sems can gyi don dpag tu med par bsgrub par bya'o snyam pa ste/ de yang sbyang gzhi tha mal gyi 'dod chags kyi bsam pa sngar skyes pa dang / da skye 'gyur gyi bag chags thams cad sbyong byed chos kyi 'du shes su bsgyur nas sgom pa yin/ bzhi pa dgos pa ni/ rje btsun rtse mos/ de ltar 'du shes gsum sgom pas/ /tha mal rnam rtog zhi byed dang / /lus ngag bha ga bsam pa gsum/ /mchog tu gyur pa byas pa yin/ /zhes sogs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa 'khor kyi lha mo dbyung ba la/ lha mo'i rgyu spyan drangs pa/ de thig ler zhu ba dang / de las sa bon du gyur pa/ de las lha mor gyur pa/ de mngal nas spro ba'o/ /dang po gang gis spyan 'dren pa ni/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ rtsa sgo gnyis nas byung ba'i ha ha la sogs pa'i sgra dang / thugs ka'i 'od zer gyi spyan 'dren/ gang spyan 'dren na/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rigs lnga yab yum gyi rnam par spyan 'dren/

lam yab kyi zhal nas zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar bab pa las thig le brgyad du gyur/ de'i sbyang gzhi rang gi spun zla ming sring sogs dang / rang mngal skyes su skyes pa dang / skye 'gyur gyi bag chags thams cad thig le'i rnam pas yum gyi rtsa sgo gnyis nas byung te/ sngar gyi thig le dang 'dres pas sa bon brgyad du gyur/ de lha mo brgyad du gyur pa rnams rang gi ming sring sogs dang / rang mngal skyes su skyes te lus sems kyi 'phel ba rnams sbyang ba yin/ de nas mkha' nang gi lha mo rnams rim gyis phyir spros te rang gi gdan la 'khod par gsal gdab pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ grong khyer nyams dgar khyod dang nga / /dga' ba'i shin du rol pa las/ /dkar mo dbang po'i phyogs phyungs nas/ /shar gyi sgo ru yang dag gnas/ /zhes pa nas/ rlung gi mtshams su g.yung mo nyid/ /ces pa'i bar gyis bstan/ kha dog ni/ gau rī kha dog nag mor 'gyur/ /chom rkun ma ni rtsod dang mtshungs/ /ro langs ma ni gser btsos bzhin/ /ghasma rī ni margad mtshungs/ /pukka sī ni dbang sngon mtshungs/ /ri khrod ma ni zla nor 'od/ /gtum mo nam mkha'i sngo sangs ma/ /g.yung mo sna tshogs pa zhes brjod/ /ces dang / phyag mtshan ni/ dkar mo g.yas na gri gug te/ /de bzhin g.yon na ro hi ta/ /ces pa nas/ g.yung mo g.yas na rdo rje nyid/ /g.yon na sdig mdzub de bzhin no/ /zhes pas phyag mtshan bstan/ skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyi gnas/ /dkar mo la sogs phyag gnyis ldan/ /spyan gsum skra ni gyen du ste/ /phyag rgya lnga ni rnam par brgyan/ /zhes pas rnam 'gyur bstan/ gnyis pa bsgom tshul ni/ gong du bshad pa'i gdan so so'i snying gar shar du lha mo gau rī dag pa gnyis dang ldan pas ming dkar mo/ chos dbyings las mi 'gyur pas sku mdog nag mo/ rang brgyud kyi nyon mongs pa bcad cing gzhan brgyud kyi nyon mongs pa gcod pas na g.yas gri gug

sems can rnams 'khor ba'i mtsho las sgrol bas g.yon nya ro hi ta ste nya dmar po 'dzin pa'o/ /lhor tsau rī'i ser sna 'jur gegs kyi nor 'joms shing rku bas chom rkun ma sems can gyi don la rjes su chags pas dmar mo/ rang rgyud kyi gti mug spang zhing gzhan gti mug las slong bas g.yas cang te'u/ sems can rnams gti mug dang ldan pa mtshon pas g.yon phag pa/ nub tu baitta li rnam rtog gi srog bsod/ gti mug ye shes su langs pas ro langs ma/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan gong nas gong du rgyas pas ser mo/ 'dod chags kyi gdungs pa'i sems can mtshon byed du g.yas rus sbal/ de zhi bar byed pa'i thabs su g.yon bde chen gyi ye shes kyi gang ba'i thod pa/ byang du ghasma rī tha mal gyi rnam rtog za ba phod pas za phod ma/ 'phrin las sna tshogs pa'i sems can gyi don mdzad pas ljang gu/ zhe sdang gis gzir ba'i sems can mtshon pas g.yas sbrul/ de zhi bar byed pa'i g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba/ byang shar du pukka sī sems brgyud mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi khengs pa'i sbos mo chos nyid las mi 'gyur bas sngon mo/ nga rgyal dang ldan pa'i sems can mtshon pas g.yas seng ge de gcod par byed pas g.yon dgra satwa ste/ mer sha wa rī bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pas dben par gnas pa'i ri khrod ma/ dag pa gnyis ldan gyi dkar mo bdag 'dzin spangs pas g.yas dge slong / ser sna'i 'dud pa grol bas g.yon gsil byed/ srin por gdol pa mo gzung 'dzin gyi srog gcod pas gtum mo/ sems can gyi don la chags pas sngo la dmar ba'i mdangs can/ chos 'khor bskor bas g.yas 'khor lo/ nyon mongs pa'i tha ba rlog pas g.yon thod pa/ rlung du ḍoṃ bi nī rnam rtog gi me sreg pa'i g.yung mo/ 'phrin las sna tshogs pas sems can gyi don mdzad pas kha dog sna tshogs pa/ brla man chad rkang mthil rlung yin pas sngon po/

sum mdo me yin pas dmar po/ lto ba chu yin pas dkar po/ snying ga sa yin pas ser po/ mgrin pa me yin pas dmar po/ spyi bo rlung yin pas ljang gu/ tha mal gyi rnam rtog 'joms pas g.yas rdo rje/ gdug pa can la sdigs pas g.yon sdigs mdzub/ lha mo thams cad kyang chos thams cad de bzhin nyid ro gcig tu rtogs pas zhal gcig ma/ bden pa gnyis zung du 'jug pas phyag gnyis ma/ rdo rje gsum gyi go 'phang brnyes pas spyan gsum ma/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan yongs su rdzogs pas skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib g.yog dang bral bas gcer bu/ rgyal ba rigs lnga dag pas rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan pa/ ye shes lnga'i yon tan yongs su rdzogs pas thod pa skam po lngas dbu brgyan pa/ ā li kā li lnga bcu dag pas thabs kyi rang bzhin mi mgo skam po lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ mi gnas pa'i myang 'das mtshon pas zhabs g.yon brkyang gi skyil krung phyed pas gar gyis zhugs pa/ de'i sbyang gzhi ni lha mo phyogs ma bzhis zhe sdang nga rgyal 'dod chags phrag dog de bzhin du gti mug spyi khyab yin/ yang gzugs phung / tshor ba'i phung po/ 'du shes kyi phung po/ 'du byed kyi phung po/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po spyi khyab ste/ de rnams sbyong byed mtshams ma bzhis sa chu me rlung rnams sbyangs pas phyogs ma bzhi'i me long lta bu'i ye shes/ mnyam nyid sor rtog bya ba grub pa'i ye shes rnams lha mo phyogs ma bzhir bsgyur te bsgom/ byams pa snying rje dga' ba btang snyoms te tshad med bzhi'i ngo bo lha mo mtshams ma bzhir bsgyur nas bsgom/ kha dog gi sbyang gzhi ni nag po dang sngon po chos dbyings ye shes/ dkar po me long ye shes/ ser po mnyam nyid ye shes/ dmar po sor rtog ye shes/ ljang gu bya grub ye shes te/ kha dog de dag ye shes de dag tu bsgyur nas bsgom/ phyag mtshan ni rdo rje gri gug kha ṭwāṃ ka dgra satwa la sogs pa rnams chos dbyings ye shes su bsgom/

'khor lo la sogs pa me long ye shes su bsgom/ rin po che la sogs pa mnyam nyid ye shes su bsgom/ thod pa la sogs pa sor rtog ye shes su bsgom/ sna tshogs rdo rje dril bu sogs bya grub ye shes su bsgom/ phyag mtshan srog chags rnams la phung po lnga/ 'byung ba lnga skye mched bcu gnyis tshigs chen bcu ste gdan gsum tshang bas mtshon don shin du bzang ba yin/ rnam 'gyur yang zhabs dang phyag g.yas brkyang rnams thugs rje chen pos sems can gyi khams la khyab pa mtshon/ phyag zhabs g.yon bskum ni shes rab chen pos chos gang du yang mi 'dzin pa mtshon/ g.yon rnams brkyang g.yas rnams bskum pa yang de bzhin no/ /zhabs skyil krung dang phyag thugs kar bsnol ba ni zung 'jug mtshon/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa ni phyi nang gi gdon ma lus pa bsreg pa mtshon/ gau rī la sogs pa'i ming yang sngon byung dang chos mtshungs pa yin/ gau rī nag mo 'byung ba yin/ rnam snang la rigs lnga yod pa'i nang nas gau rī mi bskyod pa rnam par snang mdzad yin/ des tsau rī dang baitta li yang mtshon pa yin// ༈ //gsum pa rgyu rdo rje 'chang thig ler zhu ba ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ de nas rdo rje 'chang chen las/ /rig mar bcas par zhu bar gyur/ /zhes gsungs te/ rgyu gang zhu ba/ rkyen gang gis zhu ba/ rnam pa ji ltar zhu ba/ de la nga rgyal bzung ba/ de'i dgos pa dang lnga las/ dang po ni/ rgyu rdo rje 'chang gi phung khams skye mched thams cad do/ /gnyis pa la gnyis kyi dang po ni/ yab yum snyoms par zhu ba'i rkyen gyis yab yum sku thams cad dwangs ma byang chub kyi sems kyi gang bas zag med bde chen gyi ye shes skyes par mos pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dri za zhugs pa'i rkyen gyis de ltar snyoms par zhugs pas bde ba skyes pa dang / sngar bar snang du bzhag pa'i yig 'bru lnga yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu/

sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar bab pa'i rkyen gyis phung khams skyed mched thams cad zhu ba yin/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprad na sbyang gzhi rang gi pha ma nyal po byas pa dang byed par snang ba thams cad sbyong byed rgyu rdo rje 'chang yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa des sbyong zhing bar do byas pa dang byed par 'gyur ba'i bar do'i lus ngag yid gsum sred len dang bcas pa thams cad kyai rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs kyi thabs shes kyi ngo bo yig 'bru lnga'i rnam par shar ba des sbyong zhing bar do pha ma'i khu khrag dang bcas pa mngal du 'dres pa/ yig 'bru lnga yab yum dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas 'dres pas sbyong / gsum pa ni/ bde stong dbyer med kyi ngo bo thig le zlum po sngo skya rnam par gyur pa yin la/ de yang yab zhu ba'i cha ni bde chen/ longs sku'i ngo bo yum zhu ba'i cha ni stong pa chos sku'i ngo bo bsgom pa yin te/ rtse mos/ yab zhu ye shes yum zhu dbyings/ /dbyer med thig le'i gdan stengs su/ /de ni longs sku la brten pa'i/ /dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med pa'i/ /chos sku'i ngo bo zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /bzhi pa ni/ rang nyid thig le la nga rgyal bzung nas sngags kyi byin gyis rlabs so/ /de yang sbyang gzhi phung po lnga'i chos nyid yul drug gi nang nas chos/ yid kyi rnam shes yid kyi dbang po ste/ rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs/ kha dog nag po la sogs pa ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad sbyong byed rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo thig le'i rnam par bsgom pas sbyangs 'bras rdo rje'i go 'phang thob pa yin/ lnga pa de lta bu'i dgos pa ni/ gnyis snang gi rtog pa thams cad bsdus te lhan skyes kyi ngang la mnyam par gzhag pas rdzogs rim gyi smin byed du 'gro zhing chos sku'i don rtogs pa'i dgos pa yod/ bzhi pa/ glus bskul nas 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa bzhengs pa ni/

rje btsun rtse mos/ gtso bo thig le la zhugs dang / /lha mo mtshams ma bzhi po yis/ /mgon med par ni gtso bo dang / /'phrad par 'dod na glu'i bskul/ /zhes sogs pas/ gang la bskul/ gang gis bskul/ ji ltar bskul/ bskul ba'i dgos pa/ bskul nas bzhengs pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ ngo bo bde stong gnyis med kyi ye shes/ rnam pa thig ler gnas pa la'o/ /gnyis pa gang gis bskul ba ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ de nas lha mo rnams kyis bskul/ /zhes gsungs kyang / lha mo gang gis bskul bar ma byung yang / gur las/ mtshams kyi lha mos bskul bar bya/ /zhes gsungs/ lha mo mtshams ma'i bskul ba'i rgyu mtshan yang / 'bras bu'i skabs su chos sku'i ngang las ma g.yos bzhin/ gzugs sku gnyis sems can gyi don la 'bad med du bsgrub pa de lam gyi skabs su tshad med bzhi bsgom pa'i 'bras bu yin la/ mtshams ma bzhi ni tshad med bzhi dag pa yin pas so/ /gsum pa zhu ba glus bskul ba ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ sna tshogs glu yi mchod pa yis/ /zhes sogs pas/ de yang ngo bo gnyis med kyi ye shes rnam pa glur shar ba yin cing / glus mchod par gyur pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ bde chen gyi ye shes 'bar ba'i grogs su 'gyur bas so/ /glu'i tshogs ni rtsa rgyud las/ shlau ka bzhi gsungs pa'i don ni/ pukka sīs thugs rje chen pos tshul gyis/ sha ba rīs gnad la sogs pa'i tshul gyis/ tsaṇḍa līs sngon gyi thugs dam rjes su dran pa'i tshul gyis/ g.yung mos thugs dgongs yongs su rdzogs pa'i tshul gyis bskul ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rje btsun kyai rdo rje khyed sems can sdug bsngal rgyu bcas las sgrol 'dod kyis thig le las gzugs kyi skur bzhengs shig des ci bya na pukka sīs bdag dang sems can la skyabs so/ /ji ltar na zhal phyag gi stong pa'i thig le 'di spong la/ bdag la bde chen gyi longs spyod sbyor ba mdzod cig ces pa'o/

/gnyis pa ni/ gtso bo khyed med na bdag 'gums te 'chi bar 'gyur bas kyai rdo rje khyod 'bras bu chos kyi skur bzhengs shig ji ltar na stong pa'i rang bzhin thig le'i rnam pa spong la dgos pa ri khrod ma bdag gi 'dod pa'i don rnams 'bras bu grub par mdzod ces pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ dga' bzhi'i gtso bo lhan skyes kyi rang bzhin can khyod kyis lam dus su bdag he ru kar gyur nas sems can thams cad de'i go 'phangs la mgron du gnyer zhing 'god par dam bcas nas/ da de lta bu'i nus pa thob pa'i tshe/ stong nyid la bzhugs sam ci ste bzhugs pa mi rigs te/ khyod dang bral na bdag gis sems can gyi don phyogs re tsam yang mi nus pas/ gdol pa mo bdag ni gtso bo khyed thig le las bzhengs par zhu bar bgyid do/ /bzhi pa ni/ g.yung mo bdag gis kyai rdo rje khyod kyi thugs g.yo ba dang bcas par shes kyi des na gtso bo khyod ngo bo gcig las sna tshogs su sprul pa'i mig 'phrul lta bur bzhengs shig dgos pa khyod zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du med na g.yung mo bdag gi dran pa nyams pa can du 'gyur bas de phyir snying rje'i rgyun chad ma mdzod cig ces pa'o/ /man ngag snye mar gnas skabs kyi gdul byar rung ba med pa'i tshe/ bde chen gyi sku kho nar gnas la/ yod pa'i tshe gzugs skur snang nas don mdzad pa dang bstun nas glus bskul bar 'chad/ rdo rje rtse mos/ de'ang 'di ltar brgyal ba ni bzhengs su gsol bar bskul dgos pa ma yin te/ nyin mtshan dus drug tu kun la gzigs pa yin pas glus bskul ba ltar ldang bzhengs su mi btub bam zhe na/ de la yid ches yod pa ma yin kyang / sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa ni gdul bya'i snang ngo la snang ba yin no/ /de'ang 'jig rten chen por grags pa'i spyod pa la 'jig rten dag mchog tu 'dzin pas gdul bya la'ang sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa de ltar snang ba yin no/

/de lta bu sngags kyi lam du byed pa'i tshul lugs kyi sgom par 'dod pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ sngon ston pa mngon par sangs rgyas nas chos mi gsung bar bzhugs tshul bstan pa'i tshe tshangs pas gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa phul nas chos gsung bar gsol ba btab pa dang mtshungs pa'o/ /lnga pa bskul nas bzhengs pa'i tshul ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ am̐ dang hūm̐ gi rdo rje che/ /khu ba'i gzugs las bzhengs nas ni/ /zhabs rnams sa la 'debs pa dang / /lha dang lha min sdigs par mdzad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ glus bskul bas sngon gyi dam bca' dang smon lam dran pa'i stobs kyis thig le cha gnyis su song / de yab yum gyi sa bon am̐ dang hūm̐ du gyur/ de las 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum bzhengs pa yin/ de yang sbyang gzhi rigs tha mal gyi gnas skabs de/ sas rten chu'i sdud mes smin rlung gi 'phel bar byed pa de sbyong byed 'byung bzhi dag pa'i ngo bo lha mo bzhis glus bskul bas sbyong / de la mngal gyi gnas skabs su nur nur po/ mer mer po/ ltar ltar po/ gor gor po/ 'phrang 'gyur lnga rim gyi grub pa ste thig le sa bon du gyur pa sbyong / de nas mngal rdzogs te phyis btsas pas so/ /'bras bu rdo rje 'chang du bzhengs pas sbyong la/ de yang lam byed bzhi la sogs pas zin par bya'o/ /lnga pa de gsal btab pa la/ rgyud las gsung tshul/ gsung ba'i don bstan pa/ de'i sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ zhal brgyad pa la zhabs bzhi pa/ /phyag ni bcu drug dag gi brgyan/ /zhes pas na/ rtsa ba'i zhal ni nag po che/ /g.yas pa la ni kunda mtshungs/ /g.yon pa dmar zhing cher 'jigs pa/ /spyi bo'i zhal ni rtsigs pa can/ /spyan gyi nyi shu rtsa bzhi che/ /lhag ma'i zhal ni bung ba bzhin/ /zhes pa'i bar dang / glang po rta bong glang rnga mong / /mi dang sha rā bha byi la/ /zhes pa nas/

sa dang chu dang rlung dang ni/ /me dang zla ba nyi ma nyid/ /mthar byed dang ni nor sbyin nyid/ /ces sogs dang / sgeg cing dpa' ba mi zhes sogs kyi bstan no/ /gnyis pa sku mdog gsal btab pa la/ nyams dgu gsal btab pa/ yab yum gsal btab pa'o/ /dang po ni snang stong dbyer med dam thabs snying rje chen po dang dmigs med kyi shes rab gnyis su med pa'i kyai rdo rje de 'bras bu rdo rje 'chang gi rnam par bzhengs pa'i tshe/ sku mdog sngon po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa'i rnam par shar ba yin te/ de la sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyangs 'bras thams cad kyi mtshon byed khyad par can yod pas so/ /gsal 'debs tshul ni dkyus bzhin ste/ chos nyid las mi 'gyur bas sku mdog sngon po/ rnam par thar pa brgyad dag pas zhal brgyad/ rdo rje snying 'grel gyi yig sna las/ dbang phyug gi 'khor gyi lha rnams la/ sa'i zhal/ chu me rlung nam mkha' nyi ma zla ba sgra gcan brgyad yod pa'i nga rgyal bcag pa dang / 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad spangs pa'i brdar/ zhal brgyad pa zhes bshad/ rtsa zhal sngon po mdun du gzigs pa g.yas g.yon du zhal gsum gsum 'dab chags su bsgrigs pa/ rtsa zhal gyi spyi bor mgrin pa dang bcas pa'i steng zhal mdun du bstan pa/ de yang rang bzhin dang glo bur gyi dri ma dag pas g.yas zhal dkar po snying rje'i sems can la chags pas g.yon gyi dang po dmar po/ mi 'gyur bas g.yas g.yon gyi lhag ma bzhi nag po/ thabs shes zung du 'jug pas steng zhal dud ka khams gsum la gzigs shing dus gsum mkhyen pas zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa'i dbus ma ni g.yon gyen du langs pa lta bu/ bdud bzhi 'joms pas zhal gyi mche ba bzhi cung zad gtsigs pa/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad yongs su rdzogs pas dbu skra ser po gyen du 'khyil ba/ rtsa zhal gyi spyi gtsug tu dbu'i gtsug tor de'i mdun du 'phrin las sna tshogs pas sems can gyi don mdzad pas sna tshogs rdo rjes spras pa'o/

/phyag bcu drug pa ni/ kha che rin po che rdo rjes/ zhal bzhi pa la dpung pa bzhi/ /phyag bzhi pa la zhabs bzhi pa/ /zhes pa dang mthun par mgrin pa dang 'brel ba'i sog pa bcu drug de dang 'brel ba'i dpung pa bcu drug de dang 'brel ba'i phyag bcu drug mdun rgyab du brtsegs pa/ phyag de rnams ni stong nyid bcu drug rnam par dag pa yin la/ phyag gi thod pa bcu drug ni shes rab la sbyar la stong nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes bcu drug ste/ yul can zung 'brel mtshon/ yang stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab bcu drug gis dngos 'dzin gyi mgo bo bcad pas thod pa bcu drug go /thabs la sbyar na snying rje bcu drug mtshon pas/ stong pa dang snying rje zung du 'jug go /yang thod pa ni bde skyong ste dga' ba bcu drug gi ngo bo yin pas/ bde stong zung 'jug mtshon/ de yang g.yas kyi thod pa brgyad na gnas pa'i srog chags brgyad kyis ni/ glo dang dbugs dang de bzhin smyo/ /khong skam mdze dang bi dzi ka /mchin pa mcher pa'i nad rnams la/ /glang po la sogs rim shes bya/ /zhes pa ltar nad brgyad rnam par dag pa mtshon/ sems can rnams kyi kha nang du bstan pa ni sems can gyi nad rnams rang la len pa mtshon/ srog chags rnams thod pa'i nang du bzung ba ni/ nad de dag bde chen gyi ngang du bsgyur ba mtshon/ sngon byung la bcom ldan 'das kyi phyag g.yas kyi phyag mtshan rnams las 'od zer 'phros nas sems can thams cad kyi nad rnams bsdus nas zhi bar mdzad pa yin la/ rjes 'jug gi rnal 'byor pas kyang de bzhin du nyams su blang bar bya'o/ /de nyams su blangs pas nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong med par 'gyur/ de med pas 'bras bu nad brgyad khri bzhi stong med/ de med pas bkres pa dang skom pa med/ de med pas 'chi ba med/ de med pas sdug bsngal dang ngan 'gro med do/ /g.yon gyi thod pa brgyad na gnas pa'i lha brgyad ni ci 'dod byed dang yon tan brgyad pa'o/

/zhes pa ltar gyi dbang phyug brgyad mtshon cing sngon byung bcom ldan 'das kyi g.yon gyi phyag mtshan rnams las 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phun tshogs thams cad bstsal ba yin la/ rjes 'jug gis kyang de bzhin du bsgoms par bya'o/ /lha rnams kha phyir bstan pa ni sems can la dbang phyug brgyad stsol ba mtshon la/ phyag yang g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon skyabs sbyin/ lha dang dbang phyug rim par sbyar ba ni/ sku dang sas brten byed par 'gyur/ gsung dang chus gzhan rjes su 'dzin par 'gyur/ thugs dang mes sems gsal bar 'gyur/ rdul dang rlung gis g.yo bar 'gyur/ kun 'gro dang zla ba'i 'od zer thams cad la 'jug par 'gyur/ ci 'dod byed dang nyi ma'i smin byed du 'gyur/ 'phrin las dang gshin rje mthu ldan du 'gyur/ yon tan dang nor sbyin gyi dbul ba bsal bar mtshungs pa de yang gshin rje las mi mthun phyogs 'grib pa 'ba' zhig dang / nor sbyin gyi mthun phyogs 'ba' zhig lhag ma drug gi gnyis ka'i bya ba byed/ phyag dang po gnyis yum 'khyud pa ni thabs shes zung du chud pa'o/ /ye shes lnga'i yon tan yongs su rdzogs pas dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lngas dbu brgyan pa/ shes rab kyi rang bzhin mgo bo rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can pha rol du phyin pa drug gi ngo bo rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ bsdu dngos bzhi'i rang bzhin zhabs bzhi pa la mi 'dra ba du ma 'dug na'ang / rang lugs spyi mig nas brla so sor gyes te mdun rgyab du sgrig pa'i g.yas gnyis brkyang pa'i brla la g.yon gnyis bskum pa'i sor mo gtad pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa yin te/ rtsa rgyud las/ nyi mar bzhugs shing rol mor bcas/ /zhes pa ste/ yang 'gyur du/ nyi mar bzhugs shing gar stabs ldan/ /zhes pa dang / gur las/ skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs/ /zhes gsungs/

rje btsun rtse mos/ de dag kyang mnyam par brtsegs pa'i snying gar zhabs g.yas pa gnyis ni mnan pa'o/ /rol mo'i tshul gyi skyil krung phyed pa'o/ /de'i g.yas brkyang pa ni sems can la thugs rjes khyab pa'o/ /g.yon bskum pa ni shes rab kyi chos gang yang mi 'dzin par btang ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ padma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i gdan la zhabs g.yas gnyis thugs rje chen pos sems can la khyab pas na mya ngan las 'das pa la mi zhugs pa'i phyir zhabs g.yas brkyangs pa'o/ /shes rab kyi chos gang yang mi 'dzin pas 'khor bar mi zhugs par bstan pa'i phyir zhabs g.yon bskum pa'o/ /gar mkhan ltar cha lugs sna tshogs kyis sems can gyi don mdzad pas na skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa'o/ /gnyis pa gar gyi nyams dgu la gsum las/ sku'i nyams gsum ni/ sgeg cing dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ /zhes pas bstan no/ /sgeg pa ni rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i sku lta ba'i chog mi shes pa dang ldan pas gdul bya 'dod chags can 'dul bar byed/ dpa' ba ni bdud bzhi mnan pa'i sku che zhing brjid pa des zhe sdang can 'dul bar byed/ mi sdug pa ni khro chags sogs rnam 'gyur du ma dang ldan pa des gti mug can 'dul bar byed/ gsung gi nyams gsum ni/ rgod dang drag shul 'jigs rung ba/ /ces pa ste/ rgod pa ni/ rab tu dges shing chags pas bzhad sgras 'dod chags can 'dul bar byed/ drag shul ni/ hūm̐ phaṭa la sogs pa'i nga ros zhe sdang can 'dul bar byed/ 'jigs su rung ba ni/ rtag chad du 'dzin pa rnams 'jigs par byed pa snang stong zung du 'jug pa'i gsung des gti mug can 'dul bar byed/ thugs kyi nyams gsum ni/ snying rje rngams dang zhi ba yi/ /zhes pa ltar gsum yin/ snying rjes sems can rjes su 'dzin par bzhed pa ste 'dod chags can 'dul/ rngams pa ni byams pa chen pos rab tu khro bar mdzad pa ste zhe sdang can 'dul/

zhi ba ni zung 'jug zhi ba chen pos thugs kyi log lta dang ldan pa'i gti mug 'dul/ gsum pa ni/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje bdag med mas gang zag dang chos kyi bdag gnyis stong pas bdag med ma gzhung bzhin gsal btab ste/ dag pa ni gong du bshad pa rnams kyi shes so/ /gsum pa ni/ chos rje sa paṇa gyis/ lha'i sku la sbyang gzhi dang / /sbyong byed 'phrod pa'i rten 'brel yod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ lha'i zhal phyag rgyan la sogs pa dang sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprad de bsgom pa gal che bas zhib tu bshad na/ sbyong byed zhal brgyad kyi sbyang gzhi rnam shes tshogs brgyad/ de'i char sgo 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad/ de gnyis kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i las sgrib thams cad rnam thar brgyad 'phags lam brgyad/ mthar thug gi dbang phyug brgyad rnams zhal brgyad kyi rnam par bsgyur nas bsgom/ phyag bcu drug gi 'pho ba bcu drug skye mched bcu gnyis skye rga na 'chi bzhi ste bcu drug sbyong / zhabs bzhis skye gnas bzhi sbyong / spyan nyer bzhis dbang po nyer gnyis gsal stong gnyis te nyer bzhi sbyong / mche ba zla ba phyed pa lta bus bdag gces 'dzin sbyong / thod pa'i 'phreng bas nyer len gyi phung po lnga'i dbang gis sdug bsngal gyi 'phreng ba 'khor mo 'byung ba de sbyong / mdor na sbyang gzhi rnams 'khor ba sbyong byed rnams myang 'das/ de gnyis dbyer med du bsres nas rnal 'byor pas sems kun gzhi gcig gi steng du gtan la phab ste nyams su len pa ni mchog yin no// ༈ //gnyis pa sems dpa' sum rtsegs su bsgom pa ni/ gur las/ thams cad rnams kyi sngags 'di yis/ /snying rjer ye shes gnas su dgod/ /ces gsungs pa'i don rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum las/ 'di'i skabs su bsdus pa bsgom pa nyams len yin pas de'i bsgom tshul ni/ yab kyi thugs kar nyi ma/ yum dang lha mo rnams kyi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du rang rang gi sa bon thig les brgyan pa bsgom ste/

sa bon rnams ye shes sems dpa'/ thig le rnams ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'/ rang lhar sgom pa dam tshig sems dpa' gnyis po sems dpa' sum rtsegs bsdus pa'i lugs so/ /sbyang gzhi tha mal pa'i lus ngag yid gsum sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje gsum gyis sbyong / gsum pa snod bcud kyi zhing sbyong ba ni/ rje rtse mos/ de yang lha dgu'i thugs ka yi/ /rang rang sa bon las 'od 'phros/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don gtso 'khor thams cad kyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer kha dog sna lnga shangs bug g.yas nas phyir 'phros snod bcud kyi 'jig rten la phog pas/ gser 'gyur gyi rtsis lcags nag po la phog pa ltar snod gzhal yas khang dang bcud lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor du byas nas 'od zer sna bug g.yon nas bsdus te thugs ka'i sa bon la thim/ sbyang gzhi 'dis ma dag pa'i snod bcud kyi snang ba thams cad sbyong // ༈ //bzhi pa mig sogs byin gyis brlab pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma sogs nas/ yid la phrag dog rdo rje ma'i bar dang / gur las/ mig la sogs par gti mug sogs/ /rdo rje gsum ni gnas gsum dgod/ /ces dang / gti mug rdo rje mig la dgod/ /zhe sdang rdo rje rna ba la/ /ser sna 'dod chags de bzhin du/ /dge dang bdag med bsgom par bya/ /phyag gnyis zhal ni gcig pa yin/ /zhes pa nas/ gnas gsum du ni gnas par sgom/ /zhes gsungs pa rnams kyi don ni/ mi 'dra ba du ma snang na'ang / rang lugs lha dgu'i dam tshig la bkod de/ gtso bo ni rtsa zhal kho na'i spyan g.yas g.yon gnyis snyan gnyis shangs ljags thugs ka dpral ba ste drug 'khor rnams la'ang de bzhin dang / gtso 'khor thams cad kyi gnas gsum du sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje gsum ste lha thams cad la dgu dgu bkod/ bskyed tshul ni gdong drug gi rgyud las/ mig sogs byin gyis rlabs pa la/ /gti mug rdo rje sogs kyis bsrungs/

/dbang sbub stong pa nyid byas te/ /snying po'i ming gi yi ge yi/ /zhes gsungs pa dang mthun par tha mal gyi dbang sbubs rnams stong par byas nas der sa bon la bskyed pa yin/ de ltar bskyed pa'i dgos pa yang / rje btsun rtse mos/ de ltar go cha dgos pa las/ dgos pa rnam pa gsum yod de/ /tha mal rnam rtog blo bzlog dang / /mngon par shes pa lnga char dwangs/ /bar chad bgegs las bsrung ba ste/ /zhes sogs pa'i dgos pa dang po ni/ gur las/ gti mug rdo rje rab sbyor bas/ /mig gi rnam par shes pa sbyangs/ /zhe sdang rdo rje'i bsam pa yis/ /sgra yi sgo yang bsam pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ mig shes sogs drug sbyong dgos pa gnyis pa ni/ gti mug rdo rje sbyor ba las/ /rdo rje'i mig gis mthong bar 'gyur/ /zhes sogs pas mngon par shes pa dang po lnga thob/ dgos pa gsum pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ 'di ni go cha sems dpa' che/ /zhes sogs pas bar chad dang bgegs bsrung ba'o/ /de rnams kyi sbyang gzhi ni/ sems can tha mal pa'i phung khams skye mched dang lus ngag yid gsum rgyas pa sbyong / lnga pa ye shes pa dgug gzhug ni/ dam tshig 'khor lo chen po 'bar/ /ye shes 'khor lo myur gzhug bya/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dag /bsgrub byed gzhan du ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pas ye shes pa gzhug pa la/ ngag gi spyan 'dren pa tshogs zhing dang 'dra bas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i snying po kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'dus par bsam la lha mo brgyad kyis mchod/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma sogs kyis bstod/ /de nyid dgug gzhug bya ba ni/ gur las/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro lug gu brgyud/ /zhen pa chen po sangs rgyas kun/ /lcags sgrogs rdo rje bcing bar bya/ /dga' ldan du ni lhag mar 'gyur/ /ces dang / lcags kyu nyid kyi dgug par bya/

/zhags pa nyid kyi gzhug bya zhing / /lcags sgrog gi ni zhabs dag cing / /dril bu 'khrol ba'i dbang du bya/ /zhes dang / rin chen 'bar ba las/ gau rī la sogs lha mo bzhis/ /dgug gzhug bcing dang dgos pa bskyed/ /ces sogs pa'i don gau rī la sogs lha mo bzhis/ sngags kyi dang po brjod pa'i tshe/ rang gi thugs ka nas gau rī nag mo lcags kyu thogs pa grangs med spros/ ye shes pa'i lha thams cad kyi thugs kar lcags kyus reg pas nye bar spyan drangs/ gong bzhin tsau rī dmar mo zhags pa thogs pa spros te/ ye shes pa rnams kyi thugs kar reg pas dam tshig pa rnams kyi smin mtshams nas thim/ yang gong bzhin baitta lī ser mo lcags sgrog thogs pa spros/ ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa 'dres pa'i lcags sgrog zhabs rnams la reg pas ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa dbyer med tu 'dres/ yang thugs ka nas gong bzhin ghasma rī ljang khu dril bu thogs pa spros/ dril bu'i sgra phyogs kun du dkrol bas ye shes pa thams cad dam tshig pa la dgyes te sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du ye shes pa dbyer med du bzhugs par bsgom/ ye shes pa bcug pa'i dgos pa ni rje btsun rtse mos/ de ltar dam tshig 'khor lo la/ /ye shes bstims pa'i dgos pa yang / /'di ltar kha cig dam tshig pa/ /dman 'dzin ye shes mchog tu 'dzin/ /de ltar 'dzin pa'i gang zag gis/ /ye shes dgug gzhug ma byas na/ /dam tshig 'ba' zhig gzugs brnyan tsam/ /lam du byas min de mi 'grub/ /de bas dam tshig 'khor lo la/ /ye shes bcug pas de rtogs pas/ /'bras bu 'byin yin yang dag par/ /de ltar med kyang de dgos gsungs/ /zhes dang / dgongs pa lung ston las/ /gser 'gyur rtsi yi dngos po yis/ /lcags ni gser du bsgyur bar byed/ /de bzhin ye shes bcu pa yis/ /mi'i lus ni sangs rgyas byed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar yin no/ /ye shes bcug pa'i sbyang gzhi ni/

ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dam tshig par bsgyur/ dam tshig pa'i dkyil 'khor de ye shes pa thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par lam byed bzhis bsgyur nas bsgom/ 'di yan chad rjes su chags pa rdo rje sems dpa'i yan lag yin te/ yan lag 'di nyon mongs pa 'dod chags bde chen rdo rje'i tshogs lam du byed pa yin zhing / rdo rje sems dpa' yang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rtsa ba bde chen gyi ngo bo yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de la 'phros nas zab mo lus kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa ni mngon rtogs dang sbrel na rjes su chags pa'i yan lag du bsdu ba yin/ de lta bu'i lus dkyil bsgom tshul ni rgya gzhung las gsung tshul rnams/ lus dkyil rtsod spong du shes par bya/ dmigs pa bsgom tshul ni/ ye shes pa bcug pas/ lus sems la zag med kyi bde ba chen po'i ye shes skyes pa des zab mo lus kyi dkyil 'khor du rnam pa shar ba de rnams rim gyi gsal btab pa ni/ dpral ba dang ltag pa gnyis rna ba gnyis kyi steng rnams su sna tshogs rdo rje shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / lte ba mthing nag can du bsgom/ rkang mthil rdo rje'i sa gzhi ni lpags pa'i nang du rdo rje sngon po rwa gdengs pa nas thang brdal ba lta bu bsgom/ rtsib ma rdo rje'i rwa ba ni rtsib ma'i phyi logs rnams la/ rdo rje sngon po rtse gsum pa rwa gdengs pa shel la gzugs brnyan shar ba'i tshul gyi bsgom/ lpags pa rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre ni lpags pa'i nang sha la sbyar pa'i phyogs la ko rlon la spar btab pa'i tshul gyi rdo rje sngon po rtse gsum par bsgom/ ba spu mda'i drwa ba ni/ ba spu'i rtsa ba re na rtsa phra mo re zug pa'i rtse mo rnams stong nang la bstan rtse mde'u phyi la bstan pa'i mde'u snol ba'i phra mo re bsgom/ sen mo me ris 'bar ba ni/

sen mo dang sha sbyar ba'i mtshams nas me kha dog lnga pa phra mo re 'bar ba yin/ rkang mthil rlung ni/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi'i steng du/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor 'od ma'i gzhu lta bu re bsgom/ sum mdo me ni/ sum mdor rtse mo phra ba mthur la bstan/ gdeng ka bye ba gyen du bstan pa'i zur gsum bsgom/ lto ba chu ni/ lto ba'i thad kyi nang du chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po dpangs cung zad dang bcas pa bsgom/ snying kha sa ni snying kha'i dbus su sa'i dkyil 'khor kha dog ser po gru bzhi pa dpangs cung zad dang bcas pa bsgom/ sgal tshigs ri rab ni/ sgal tshigs sa nyi shu rtsa gcig yang ri rab yongs su rdzogs pa re re bsgom/ mgo bo ri rab kyi stod kyi cha ni/ 'khur 'tshos kyi steng mig rus kyi stod gnyis rna ba'i rgyab phyogs kyi 'bur gnyis te bzhi ni cog bzhi/ lus mi mnyam pa med pa gru bzhi ni spyi gtsug dang rkang mthil gnyis lag mthil gnyis rnams su gzhal yas khang gi grwa'i rnam pa rtsig pa rim pa lnga re bsgom/ snying ga nas 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung rgyu ba'i sgo bzhi ni snying ga'i phyogs kyi rtsa bzhi sgo chung gnyis sral ma'i rnam pa can bsgom/ mig pañtsa re kha'i rtsig pa ni mig gnyis kyi rgyal mo'i dkyil du rtsig pa rim pa lnga phra khyug pa re bsgom/ sna rin po che'i pha gu ni sna'i 'dom so na lpags pa'i nang du pha gu se khyug pa gcig bsgom/ so drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang ba ni ya so ma so rnams drwa ba dang drwa phyed kyi rnam pa shel la gzugs brnyan shar ba'i tshul gyi bsgom/ lce dang mchu 'dod yon gyi snam bu ni/ lce dang mchu'i dbus su 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar khyug pa re bsgom/ rna ba rta bab ni rna ba'i nang gro kha'i mdzer pa lta bu'i mdun du rta bab bang rim bzhi pa'i rnam pa can re bsgom/ rkang rnams ka ba'i tshogs ni/ rkang lag gi rkang brgyad brgyad zhogs kyi rnam pa can zhu ring zhu thung dang bcas pa bsgom pa ni rten gyi dkyil 'khor yin/

brten pa lha bskyed pa ni/ pho brang lnga'i gnas su rten dkyil 'khor bzhi'i rang bzhin yig 'bru lnga 'byung ba lnga phung po lnga nyon mongs pa lnga rnams las rgyal ba rigs lnga yum lnga ye shes lnga rnams su gyur pa gsal btab pa ni/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo la sogs pa pho brang lnga'i yig 'bru lnga las gtso bo yab yum bcu/ 'khor rnams rtsa 'dab rnams las lha mo rnams bskyed pa yin pas/ ngag 'don rnams lus dkyil ji lta ba bzhin byed/ nang skye mched drug gi skyed gzhi ni/ mig gi rnam par shes pa sogs kyi rten/ mig dbang zar ma'i me tog lta bu/ rna dbang gro kha'i 'dzer pa lta bu/ sna dbang zangs kyi mo khab mthur du gshib pa lta bu/ lce dbang zla ba phyed pa lta bu lce'i dbus su/ lus dbang smin ma sbrel mtshams su thig le dkar po/ yid dbang snying kha'i dbu ma'i nang bzhugs/ yum rnams kyi bskyed gzhi ni/ de dag gi gzhon par gyur pa'i rlung rnams yin te/ /bskyed gzhi de dag las yul yul can gyi lha mo rnams bskyed pa yin/ khro bo bcu'i gnas ni lag pa'i mkhrig ma'i tshigs gnyis dpung pa'i tshigs gnyis rkang pa'i slog mor gyi tshigs gnyis pus mo'i tshigs gnyis spyi gtsug sku'i rdo rje'i steng / lce'i rtsa ba gsang gnas kyi nor bu'i dbus te bcu rnams su nad 'du ba gzhi bskyed par byed pa'i rtsa 'dab bcu gnyis pa'i dbus na stobs kyi hūm̐ drag la ring ba bcu yod pa rnams las bskyed pa yin/ lha de rnams lha'i rnam par bzhugs nas sku'i dbyibs ngo bo bde bar gnas pas rnam pa bde ba/ bde stong zung du chud pas rang bzhin gsal stong / de thams cad re re'i steng na yang bde chen gyi ye shes rgyun ma chad cing ngo bo stong par rtogs pas bde stong zung du chud pa yin/ gzhan yang lus rtsa thams cad sprul pa'i sku/ yi ge thams cad longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/

khams bdud rtsi thams cad chos kyi sku/ snying po ye shes kyi rlung thams cad ngo bo nyid kyi sku de lus kyi cha shas cung zad tsam re yang sku bzhi ye shes lnga ldan gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha'i rang bzhin te shin du zab pa'i lugs yin te 'di yan chad rjes su chags pa'i yan lag gi nang du sdud/ gtso 'khor gyi lha thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma yin/ sku mdog rang rang gi mngon rtogs bzhin la pho brang lnga'i gtso bo yab rnams zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa'i phyed krung / yum rnams g.yon brkyang g.yas bskum pas yab la 'khyud pa/ yon tan rin chen 'byung ldan la rus pa dang rin po che gnyis kyi brgyan pa ni jo bo gā ya dha ra'i gzigs snang yin cing / bla ma gong ma rnams kyi byin rlabs rgyun mi chad pa'i nyams len yin/ gzhan rigs bzhi la rin po che'i rgyan med/ yum rnams sa chu me rlung nam mkha' rnams rang gi lus la gnas pa'i sa rlung la sogs pa'i rlung rnams yin/ nang gi skye mched kyi lha mo rnams skye mched bzhi tha dad pa las kha dog sna tshogs yin/ yul gyi lha mo drug rnam shes kyi zhon pa'i rlung yin pas thams cad kha dog nag mo zhal nang gzigs/ skye mched kyi lha mo drug zhal phyir gzigs yul yul can zhal sprad pa'i rnam pa can yin// ༈ //gsum pa dbang bskur ba mi bskyod pa'i yan lag ni/ rgyud las gsung tshul/ de'i don nyams su len tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ rang gi snying kar sa bon bsam mo/ /sa bon las 'od zer nag po lcags kyu'i rnam pa'i gzugs kyis phyung nas ces sogs dang / gur las/ dbang ni rigs ma brgyad rnams kyis/ /zhes gsungs pas dbang gang la blang ba'i yul/ gang gis len pa'i rten/ ji ltar len pa'i tshul dang gsum/ dang po la dbang lha spyan drangs pa/ mchod bstod byas te gsol ba btab pa'o/ /dang po ni gang gi spyan 'dren pa tshogs zhing dang 'dra/

spyan drangs pa'i dbang lha ni gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha tshogs rnams yin/ de dag gi bzhugs gnas ni gzhal yas khang gi nang gtso bo'i smin mtshams kyi thad du phyi gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i nang du lha snam rim pa gnyis pa dbus su le tshe dgu'i dbus ma la padma nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du bla ma dang tha mi dad pa'i mi bskyod pa yab yum phyogs bzhir rgyal ba rigs bzhi ste dbus ma dang lngas bdud rtsi lnga'i gang ba'i bum pa bsnams pa/ mtshams bzhir yum bzhi gri thod 'dzin pa/ de'i phyi rol lha snam dang po la phyogs bzhir byang sems gnyis gnyis te brgyad/ mtshams bzhir mchod pa'i lha mo re re ste bzhi shar phyogs kyi byang sems gnyis g.yas g.yon du mchod pa'i lha mo gnyis te drug byang sems rnams kyi bkra shis kyi rdzas dang lha mo drug gi mchod pa'i rdzas thogs la/ lha snam phyi ma'i phyogs mtshams brgyad du khro bo brgyad/ gtso bo'i steng gi nam mkha' dang le tshe dbus ma'i nang gi steng 'og gnyis su steng 'og gi khro bo gnyis te bcu rang rang gi phyag mtshan 'dzin pa rnams gsal btab la/ gnyis pa mchod bstod gsol ba btab pa la lha mo brgyad kyis mchod/ zhe sdang rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod kyis bstod/ de'i don ni zhe sdang dang gti mug la sogs pa sbyang gzhi/ rdo rje ni gnas gyur chos dbyings ye shes dang me long ye shes sogs sbyangs 'bras/ de la phyag 'tshal ba'o/ /rdo rje kun gyi dam tshig mgon ni sbyang gzhi nyon mongs pa de dag sbyong byed lam bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyis sbyangs pas sbyangs 'bras ye shes lnga 'grub pa las mi 'da'o/ /las rnams thams cad sgrub byed pa/ /zhes pa ni 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub thams cad khyed las 'byung zhes bya'o/ /rdo rje can kun rigs lnga rdo rje 'chang dang drug po/ bdag dges mdzod ni/

bdag la byin gyis rlobs shig ces bya ba'i don to/ /gsol ba btab pa ni/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /zhes dang / a bhi sogs te de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsol cig ces pa'o/ /maṇḍal phul/ byang chub rdo rje sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ gnyis pa gang gis dbang len pa'i brten ni/ phyi'i lha ye shes pa'i ngo bor gyur pa dgu dang lus dkyil gyi lha thams cad yin/ gsum pa ji ltar len pa'i tshul la dbang bzhi yod pa'i dang po bum dbang la/ slob ma dang slob dpon gyi dbang gnyis/ slob ma'i dbang la rig pa'i dbang lnga brtul zhugs dang drug yod pa thams cad la 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa bzhi bzhis len dgos pa yin te/ 'khor gsum slob dpon slob ma dbang rdzas gsum yongs su dag pa ni swa bha was stong pa nyid du sbyang ba yin/ bzhi pa ni bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi pa yin pa rnams spyi'i don no/ /gzhung don la dang po mi bskyod pa chu'i dbang ni sbyang gzhi nyon mongs pa zhe sdang rnam shes kyi phung po yid chu'i khams la sogs pa ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad swa bhā was stong pa nyid chos sku'i rang bzhin du sbyangs pas 'chi ba sbyongs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma raṃ las nyi ma gnyis kyi gang du skye ba'i gnas sbyangs/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pas bar do sbyangs/ de las 'od 'phros 'dus pa las yab mi bskyod pa yum mā ma ki gnyis sku mdog phyag mtshan zhabs rnams lus dkyil ji lta ba bzhin bskyed pas rigs drug gang du skye ba blang ba de sbyongs/ de'i skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis rlabs pas lus rgyas te tshor ba sbyongs/ de la ye shes pa bcug pas de'i bsam pa yongs su rdzogs pa sbyongs/ de la dbang bskur bas rang gi mnga' ris la dbang bskur ste bdag po byed pa sbyongs/ dang po stong nyid du sbyangs pas chos sku thob/

phyag mtshan sa bon dang bcas pas longs sku thob/ sku yongs su rdzogs pas sprul sku thob/ de la ye shes pa bcug pas ngo bo nyid sku thob/ de lta bu'i chu dbang thob pas zhe sdang gnas gyur nas chos dbyings ye shes mngon du byas/ rnam shes kyi phung po gnas gyur ste mi bskyod pa'i go 'phangs mngon du byas te bag chags dang sa bon brgyud la bzhag pa bsgom/ des rigs gzhan rnams la yang 'gre ste/ 'on kyang rin chen 'byung ldan gyi skabs su sa bon aṃ dang phyag mtshan rin po che/ dbang rdzas dbu rgyan/ gzhan rnams phal cher 'dra/ 'od dpag med kyi skabs sa bon dzrīṃ/ phyag mtshan padma/ dbang rdzas rdo rje/ don grub kyi skabs su sa bon khaṃ/ phyag mtshan ral gri/ dbang rdzas dril bu/ rnam snang gi skabs su sa bon bhrūṃ/ phyag mtshan 'khor lo/ dbang rdzas ni rnam snang gis sbyangs/ gzugs phung reg pas dbang rdzas mi 'byung / gzhan rnams kyi dbang rdzas lha de dang der bskyed pa slob ma ji lta ba bzhin byed/ dbang rnams bskur ba'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lngas sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyis sogs gsung / rig ma rnams kyis kolla i riṭa ṭhi sogs brjod pas tshad med kyi rtogs pa skyes/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis phun sum tshogs pa brjod cing bkra shis rdzas brgyad kyi char phab pas dbang gi rtogs pa spel/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis gzugs sdug pa sgra snyan pa sogs kyi mchod pa phul bas lus sems la zag med kyi bde ba rgyas par bsgom/ khro bo rnams kyi hūm̐ phaṭa la sogs pa'i sgo nas bgegs dang bar chad ring du sprad/ dbang gi chu rgyun gyi smin mtshams dang mgrin pa dang snying ga dang rkang mthil rnams gang bas dri ma bzhi dag dbang bzhi thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan/ mchod pa phul/ rtogs pa bskyed pa rnams thams cad 'dra/ rigs lnga'i dbang thob pa'i brdar/

dngos po kun gang dang gang du snang ba de thams cad rang gi lhag pa'i lha rigs lnga yum lnga ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i sbyang gzhi ni/ phung po lnga nyon mongs pa lnga 'byung ba lnga'i chos nyid du snang ba'i cha rnams thams cad stong pa nyid du sbyang ba sogs gong bzhin/ rdo rje sems dpa'i zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum sogs yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje lha nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang ldan pa lag pa g.yas su rdo rje'i brtul zhugs kyi don du byin// ༈ //gnyis pa slob dpon gyi dbang ni/ maṇḍal phul gsol ba lan gsum gdab/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje lag pa g.yas su thugs kyi dam tshig tu byin par mos la tshigs dang sngags brjod pas sems nyid rdo rje 'chang chen po'i thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes su byin gyis rlabs par mos la/ thog mtha' med pa'i sogs brjod pas sems de nyid kyang ye shes lngar bsgom la a las byung ba'i dril bu lha gnyis shu rtsa gsum dang ldan pa lag pa g.yon du byin pas ngag grag stong dbyer med du byin gyis rlabs par mos la/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma sogs brjod pas ngag gsung dbyangs drug bcu'i rang bzhin chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong 'byung ba'i rang bzhin du byin gyis rlabs par mos la/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis bdag sogs brjod/ de'i ngang nas swa bhā was phung khams skye mched thams cad sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng du hūm̐ dang rdo rje 'chang sngon po las rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar snol nas 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gi bzhugs pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog can rus pa'i rgyan drug gi brgyan pa'i skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis rlabs/ rang 'dra'i ye shes pa bcug ste phyag rgya sku'i dam tshig gsal btab/ gong gi rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig dang dril bu gsung gi dam tshig kyang gsal btab ste/

rdo rje che dang sogs dang / shes rab bcu drug sogs brjod/ srid pa'i bde ba shin du chung sogs brjod pas phyag rgya'i de kho na nyid rgyas par bya/ gong bzhin bum pa'i dbang bskur sogs rgyas par byas te rdo rje 'chang gi rgyas btab/ dbang gi lha las mar me gcig las gnyis 'chad kyi tshul gyi rang la thim/ rab gnas mchod pa rtogs pa bskyed pa sogs bya/ yang gsang dbang gi maṇḍal phul/ bstod pa gsol btab gdong bcings mdun gyi bla ma yab yum snyoms par zhugs te de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs yab kyi zhal du bzhugs/ thugs kar rjes chags kyi mes 'od du zhu sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa'i thig le dung dang kunda ltar dkar ba gdan gsum tshang ba de phyi nang gi lha thams cad la byin par bsam te/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sogs brjod pas gsal stong gi ting nge 'dzin gyi ngang la bzhag de ltar sogs rtogs pa brjod/ gong bzhin maṇḍal phul gsol btab sogs bya/ gdong bcings slob dpon gyi phyag rgya mtshan nyid dang ldan pa gnang bar mos te/ dga' ster sogs brjod/ phyag rgya bsten par spro'am zhes mos te/ bshang gci sogs brjod/ spro'o zhes lan btab pa'i mos pa byas te/ yang bshang gci sogs brjod/ rig ma mnyes nas padma'i che ba brjod par bsam te/ e ma nga yi sogs brjod/ bsgrub pa pos yi dam yab yum du bsam/ mkha' gsang sngags kyi byin gyis rlabs/ thabs 'di la brten nas bde chen gyi ye shes mngon du bya'o snyam du chos kyi 'du shes yas bab dang / mas stan gyi dga' ba bzhi bsgom/ gdong bkrol te rtogs pa brjod/ bzhi pa'i maṇḍal phul gsol ba btab/ gdong bcing ye shes 'di ni sogs brjod/ dbang gsum pa'i ye shes dang rang sems dbyer med du bsres te bde chen gyi ngang la bzhag gdong bkrol te rtogs pa brjod/ gtso bo'i sogs gtang rag maṇḍal dang lus longs spyod phul te deng nas sogs brjod/

mdun gyi dbang lha rnams 'od du zhu/ phyi nang gi lha thams cad kyi spyi bo nas thim pas sku lus thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gang chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ rigs bdag gi rgyas btab te/ rtsa rgyud las/ rigs 'chol bsgom pa'i sbyor ba las/ /dngos grub med cing sgrub pa'ang med/ /ces dang / phyag rgya rtags dang mtshan ma ste/ /'di ni rigs kyi mtshan mar bya/ /zhes gsungs pas chos thams cad rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa la dag par shes pa mtshon pa'i phyir ngo bo nyid la ngo bo nyid kyi rgya ste sems kyi ngo bo gtso bo yab yum la/ de'i rigs mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ phyi nang gi chos thams cad rang gi sems las phyi rol du ma grub par shes pa de mtshon pa lus la sems kyi rgya ste/ sa rnam par dag pa pukka sī dang / gau rī gzugs dang gzugs phung rnam par dag pa rnam snang gi ngo bo la sems kyi ngo bo mi bskyod pas rgyas btab pa'o/ /bsrung 'khor gzhal yas khang sogs phyi rol du snang ba thams cad rang gi sems nyid de dag tu shar ba mtshon byed du sems la lus kyi rgya ste/ sgra dang tshor ba rnam par dag pa tsau rī dang chu rnam par dag pa shā ba ri mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo la lus kyi ngo bo rnam snang gi rgyas btab bo/ /rgyu ma dag pa'i snang ba rnam par dag pa'i snang bar byin gyis rlobs pa'i rgyu 'bras kyi 'brel pa nges par mtshon pa rgyu la 'bras bu'i rgya ste/ baitta lī dri dang 'du shes rnam par dag tsaṇḍa lī me rnam par dag pa 'od dpag med kyi ngo bo rgyu 'dod chags rnam dag la 'bras bu rnam dag rin 'byung gi rgyas btab bo/ /lnga pa ni 'bras bu dag pa rigs lnga ye shes lnga sogs kyang rgyu ma dag pa phung po dang nyon mongs pa sogs gnas gyur pa las 'byung ba mtshon byed ni 'bras bu la rgyu'i rgya ste/ ro dang 'du shes rnam dag ghasma rī dang rlung rnam dag g.yung mo don grub kyi rang bzhin 'bras bu phrag dog gi ngo bo la rgyu 'dod chags rnam dag 'od dpag med kyi rgyas btab bo/

/dbu rgyan rnams kyi spyi bor rang rang gi rigs kyi phyag mtshan bsgom dgos te/ gur las/ spyi bor rdo rje 'dzin pa mchog /de yang rdo rje mdog nag po/ /zhes dang / chos kyi 'khor lo spyi bor 'dzin/ /zhes so/ /des na dbu rgyan rnams ni rang rang gi rigs dang mthun pa'i dbu rgyan yin zhing / de dag gi spyi bor yang rang gi rigs kyi mtshan ma yin te/ de yang sbyang gzhi ma dag pa'i snang ba lhar byin gyis rlabs pa ni kun brtags la gzhan dbang gi rgya yin/ spyi bor rang rang gi rigs bdag bsgom pa ni gzhan dbang la gzhan dbang gi rgya yin zhing / de spyi bor rang gi rigs kyi mtshan ma 'byung ba ni lha thams cad rang bzhin med par bsgrub pa gzhan dbang la yongs grub kyi rgyas btab pa yin no/ /rigs bdag rnams ni rang 'od kyi yum dang bcas pa la longs sku'i cha byad can/ nang lus dkyil lha thams cad la rdo rje sems dpa'i rgyas btab pa gzhan dang 'dra/ de dag gi sbyang gzhi ni rnam par shes pa'i phung po chu khams kha dog sngon po zhe sdang / rang gi sems rgyud la rang gi mnga' thang dang 'byor pa rgya che chung gang yin pa'i bdag por dbang bskur ba sngar byas pa dang da byed 'gyur gyi bag chags sems snang dang bcas pa thams cad sbyong byed mi bskyod pa'i ngo bor dbang bskur ba'i rnam par bsgyur nas bsgom pas/ sbyangs 'bras khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po mi bskyod pa'i go 'phang thob pa yin no// ༈ //yan lag bzhi pa bdud rtsi myang ba ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ na dang ga ha dang po dang / /mtha' yi sha dang dang po'i sha /kyai rdo rje yi dngos grub phyir/ /bdud rtsi lnga'ang de bzhin bza'/ /zhes dang / gur las/ yang ni bdud rtsi lnga pa dang / /saṃ bu ṭi las/ dang po skye dgu'i bdag por brjod/ /de bzhin gnyis par sgrol ma nyid/ /gsum pa la ni rab mchog brjod/ /bzhi pa la ni mang po bskyed/ /lnga pa la ni stobs shes bya/

/zhes dang / gur las/ rdo rje sngags kyi gsang rtogs bya/ /zhes dang / saṃ ṭi las/ ha'i kha dog 'phrog par byed/ /hos ni dri ni 'dzin par byed/ /hris ni brtson 'grus 'jig par byed/ /ces dang / de'i dbus nas blangs nas ni/ /de nas bdud rtsir myang bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don byin gyis rlabs nas myang ba ni/ mdun du nas chang ngam bur chang sogs dngos su yod pa'am dmigs te/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sbyang gzhi ma dag pa'i rlung / sbyong byed bya ba grub pa'i ngo bo/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor de'i steng du sor rtog ye shes kyi ngo bo me'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du ma dag pa'i snod thams cad sor rtog ye shes kyi ngo bo a las thod pa yangs shing rgya che bar bsam/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor me long lta bu'i ye shes/ de'i steng du shar nas bzung te g.yas skor gyi phyogs bzhi dang dbus su/ go ku/ da/ ha/ na/ rnams las sha lnga ri rab tsam bsam/ sha lnga po sems can de dag mtshon byed yin/ sems can de dag re re yang bdud rtsi lnga lnga dang ldan pas sha re re'i steng du yang rigs lnga'i ngo bo bdud rtsi lnga lnga yod pa sbyong byed yin/ de'i steng du ye shes lnga'i ngo bo sa bon lnga bsgom pa sbyangs 'bras yin/ g.yas skor gyi ā li phrag gcig g.yon bskor gyi kā li phrag gcig brjod pas thabs shes zung du 'jug de rnams kyi steng du bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin oṃ yig dkar po mgo thur ltas de rnams sor rtogs ye shes/ de'i steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mnyam nyid ye shes/ de'i steng du hūm̐ rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes bdud rtsi he ru ka dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba thogs pa bkug te hūm̐ la thim pas rdo rje brjid dang ldan par gyur/

de'i brjid kyi nyi ma mnan/ nyi ma'i brjid kyi oṃ mnan pas thod par lhung ste/ sngar gyi bdud rtsi dang gcig tu 'dres pa bya grub ye shes/ de kha dog phun sum tshogs pa bltas pas tshim pa/ dri phun sum tshogs pa snom pas tshim pa/ ro phun sum tshogs pa myang bas tshim pa/ nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bde chen gyi ye shes bskyed nus kyi bdud rtsi yongs su rdzogs pa ni chos dbyings ye shes te/ mngon byang lnga'i sbyang gzhi gong du bshad pa yang shes par bya'o/ /de nas lha rnams kyi ljags kyi dbus su rdo rje nas 'bru tsam las 'od kyi sbu gu byung nas bdud rtsi drangs te myang pas mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor nas brgyud/ gzhir gnas kyi bdud rtsi dam tshig pa dang 'dres pas zag med kyi bde bas gang bar bsgom la nga rgyal bzung ste sngags brjod/ de'i sbyang gzhi ni 'du shes kyi phung po 'dod chags mdog dmar po zas kyi ro myang ba sogs ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad 'od dpag med kyi ngo bor bsgom// ༈ //yan lag lnga pa mchod pa ni/ gur las/ lha mo brgyad kyis mchod pa nyid/ /ces sogs pa'i don rang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas tshogs zhing gi skabs bzhin mchod rdzas thogs pa'i lha mo brgyad dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du spros te mchod par bsam la sngags brjod de nga rgyal bzung / sbyang gzhi ni 'du byed kyi phung po phrag dog kha dog ljang khu rang nyid la gnyen bshes la sogs pa'i dga' don byed pa de don grub kyi ngo bor bsgyur nas bsgom// ༈ //yan lag drug pa ni/ gur las/ 'khor lo 'dren pa bstod pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don ni gong gi mchod byed lha mo brgyad po des khyod ni rnal 'byor ma sogs kyi bstod pa'i tshig gi don ni/ dkyil 'khor gtso bo khyod bdag med ma sogs lhan cig spyod pa dang gau rī sogs rjes su 'brang ba'i tshogs kyi yongs su bskor nas rgya che ba gya nom pa/

rgyun mi chad pa zag med kyi bde bas longs spyod pa ste longs spyod rdzogs pa'i yan lag kha sbyor gyi yan lag bde chen gyi yan lag de gsum dang ldan pa'i longs sku'i rang bzhin/ gtso bo khyod ni de kho na nyid kyi don thugs su chud pas rnam par mi rtog pa'i chos sku'i dngos grub kyi mchog brnyes pas/ rang bzhin med pa'i yan lag dang ldan pa chos sku'i rang bzhin no/ /sprul sku khyod kyi rgyu ba bcud kyi sems can/ mi rgyu ba snod kyi 'jig rten na gnas pa'i 'gro ba kun don 'bad med du brgyan pa ste bsgrub shing / de'i rgyu yang dmigs med kyi snying rje'i thugs kyi sems can 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las bsad pa'am sgrol bar mdzad de/ 'jig rten na sgyu ma'i spros pa ste gdul bya gang dang gang 'dul ba'i rnam par ston/ yang rdo rje ste chos sku'i ngang du bsgrub pa ste/ de'i go 'phang la 'god pa snying rjes yongs su gang ba'i yan lag rgyun mi chad pa'i yan lag 'gog pa med pa'i yan lag gsum dang ldan pa sprul sku'i rang bzhin no/ /des na/ shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te/ /ces sogs kyi don dang ldan pas he ru ka khyod ni rdo rje ste stong nyid chos sku'i yid kyis dges pa chen po 'gyur med kyi bde ba ste/ bde stong zung 'jug gi sku brnyes pa'i kyai rdo rje khyod la phyag 'tshal lo zhes sku gsung thugs yan lag bdun ldan gyi sgo nas bstod pa'o/ /mchod bstod byed mkhan gyi lha mo rnams sna bug gnyis nas rang gi snying khar bsdus la mchod bstod kyi mnyes pa'i ngang la nga rgyal bzung ba'i sngags brjod/ sbyang gzhi rang la gzhan gyi bstod pa dang tshor ba'i phung po nga rgyal kha dog ser po rnams sbyong byed mnyam nyid ye shes kyi ngo bo rin chen 'byung ldan dngos yin snyam du bsgom/ de ltar yan lag drug rdzogs pa dang / de yang gzhal yas khang bskyed pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi yan lag tu 'jog ste rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku rnam par dag pa yin la/

sku'i yon tan thams cad kyi rten byed pa bzhin gzhal yas khang gi lha thams cad kyi rten byed do/ /rjes su chags pa rdo rje sems dpa'i yan lag yin te/ rdo rje sems dpa' lha thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin la/ rjes su chags pa yang mngon rtogs kyi rtsa ba'i snying po lta bu yin no/ /dbang bskur ba mi bskyod pa'i yan lag ni mi bskyod pa'i sbyang gzhi chu yin la/ chu'i dri ma thams cad khrus pa bzhin dbang gis sdig pa thams cad 'dag par byed do/ /bdud rtsi myang ba 'od dpag med kyi yan lag ni/ bdud rtsi mgrin pa'i gnas su myang bas ngag sbyong la 'od dpag med kyang ngag rnam par dag pa yin no/ /mchod pa don yod grub pa'i yan lag ni mchod pa 'phrin las yin la/ don yod grub pa ni bya ba'i las rnam par dag pa yin no/ /bstod pa rin chen 'byung ldan gyi yan lag ni/ bstod pa ni yon tan brjod pa yin la rin chen 'byung ldan ni yon tan rnam par dag pa yin no/ /rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor la sems bzung ste/ de yang tha mal gyi zhen pa spangs pa'i phyir nga rgyal brtan pa dang / tha mal gyi rnam pa 'gag pa'i phyir rnam pa gsal bar bsgom la sems 'dzin gyi dmigs pa rnams bsgom/ de'i rjes la rdzogs rim yang gtso bor 'khor lo bzhi la brten par bsgom/ gzhan yang ji ltar rigs pa bsgom/ rdzogs rim gyi sbyang gzhi snod kyi 'jig rten 'jig pa'i rim pa/ bcud kyi sems can 'chi ba'i rim pa/ stong par zhen pa'i cha/ lus kyi rtsa yi ge khams rlung la sogs pa ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad sbyong byed rdzogs rim gyi ye shes kyis sbyangs pas sbyangs 'bras chos sku thob pa yin no/ /yang dag par na sbyong byed re res kyang sbyang gzhi thams cad sbyong ba dang / sbyong byed thams cad kyi sbyang gzhi gcig sbyong ba dang / mdor na chos thams cad kyi snying po bsdus nas sems rgyud bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sbyong ba snying po mthar thug pa yin te/

mnyam bzhag rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor ro// ༈ //mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor la/ dag pa dran nas bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor/ gtor ma'i rnal 'byor/ kha zas kyi rnal 'byor/ rjes chags kyi rnal 'byor/ nyal ba'i rnal 'byor/ ldang ba'i rnal 'byor/ khrus kyi rnal 'byor/ spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor dang brgyad/ dang po ni spyir dag pa zhes bya ba/ ngo bo nyid la dag par bzhag pa dang / rtags sam mtshon byed la dag par bzhag pa dang / dri ma dag pa la dag par bzhag pa dang gsum las/ 'di gnyis pa rtags sam mtshon bya mtshon byed la dag par bzhag pa yin la/ de yang snying rje chen pos sems can la rjes su chags pas spyan rtsa dmar po/ byams pa'i thugs la mi 'gyur bas sku dang yan lag gnag pa/ sbyin pa dang snyan par smra ba don spyod pa don mthun pa ste/ bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi dag pas zhabs bzhi pa/ zhal brgyad ni/ gzugs can gzugs la blta ba'i rnam thar/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched dam/ rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched dam/ ci yang med pa'i skye mched dam/ 'du shes med 'du shes med min gyi skye mched dam/ 'du shes dang tshor ba 'gog pa ste 'jig rten pa'i rnam thar brgyad dang / yang dag pa'i lta ba/ rtog pa/ ngag las kyi mtha'/ 'tsho ba/ rtsol ba/ dran pa/ ting nge 'dzin te 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rnam par thar pa brgyad/ gong du bshad pa'i dbang phyug brgyad de/ mthar thug gi rnam thar brgyad do/ /phyag bcu drug ni/ nang stong pa nyid nas dngos po med pa'i stong pa nyid kyi bar bcu drug gug bskyed ni maṇa tra te/ de la skyon u byin mu tra ces pas phyag rgyar 'gyur la/ de ni rus pa'i rgyan lnga/ thal ba dang mchod phyir thogs te drug go /de ni rgyal ba rigs lnga sogs rnam par dag pa ste/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo mi bskyod pa/ /zhes sogs gdug can thams cad 'dul ba'i phyir khro bo'i cha lugs can te gdug cing gtum pa'i sems can la zhi ba nye bar mi sbyar te/

'di mkhan chen rdo rje can gyi ni/ rang nyid kyai rdo rjer 'gyur/ /zhes pa bzhin no/ /sku gsung thugs rdo rje dag pas spyan gsum rdo rje gsum gyi dag pa'i spyan zhes so/ /gzhan yang rang gi shar snang ba rnam par dag pa ni/ byams pa tshad med kyi ngo bo pukka sī/ de gsum po 'dres te g.yung mo'i rkang ni/ rus pa ma yin gyi rkang dmar po lpags rim bdun nam/ dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag chos rab tu rnam 'byed/ brtson 'grus dga' ba/ shin du sbyang pa/ ting nge 'dzin/ btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag go /rus pa'i rigs mgo bo rkang tshigs rtsib ma dang bzhi ni/ sdug bsngal kun 'byung 'gog pa lam gyi bden pa dang bzhi rnam par dag pa'o/ /drug pa 'di phyogs gcig tu ston pa ni/ sha'i rus pa'i phyi 'gengs/ khrag gi rtsa sbubs 'gengs/ khu ba dang dwangs mas mngal 'gengs/ rkang mar dang tshil gyi rkang sbub dang sha'i tshab 'gengs/ lpags pas de dag g.yogs rus pas de dag gi rten byed pa phyogs gcig tu gsungs so/ /byang chub yan lag bdun gyi mtshon nas sbyang gzhi ma dag pa'i khams rnams byang phyogs so bdun po thams cad kyis sbyongs te/ lha mo bzhis rnam pa can gyi dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi/ yang dag spong ba bzhi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhis sha khrag khu ba rkang bzhi po de sbyong / des sbyang gzhi 'byung ba lnga lnga yod pa de dbang po lnga dang stobs lngas sbyong / sbyang gzhi tshigs chen brgyad ni 'phags lam brgyad kyis sbyong / de lta bu'i dag bya dag byed dam mtshon bya mtshon byed rnams kyang 'khor 'das dbyer med du nyams su blang bar bya'o/ /de nas gzhung du dkyil 'khor bsdud par gsungs kyang / phyag len mi sdud par bzlas pa mdzad pas bzlas tshul mang du yod kyang / nyams len ni/ dang po 'phreng ba lung gi zin pa rnams tshul bzhin rgyus/ 'dud 'dzin nyis rtsegs byas byin rlabs bya tshul ni/

'phreng ba la dri zhim pos byugs/ nang mchod gtor te a mṛ tas bsangs/ stegs bu'i steng du bzhag ngag 'don ni/ rang gi lag pa g.yas pa'i sor mo lnga rdo rje rtse lnga pa lag mthil du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ ka kha gha sogs g.yas su bskor ba'i lte ba la yi ge hūm̐/ lag pa g.yon pa'i sor mo lnga padma 'dab ma lnga pa lag mthil du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la a ā sogs dbyangs yig gi g.yon du bskor ba'i lte ba la ā/ lag pa gnyis pad skor byas te phreng ba blangs la lag pa'i dbus su bzhag pa'i steng du bdud rtsi'i yi ge suṃ dkar po las 'od 'phro ba bsam/ rdo rje dang padma snyoms par zhugs pa byang chub kyi sems suṃ la khyab/ de ā li kā li la khyab/ de phreng ba dang gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ pa de pa de ma hā dzñā na sarba buddha ma yaṃ bha we ta hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a khaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags 'di dang po byin gyis rlob dus phreng bskor gcig bzlas shing / bzlas pa nam byed dus kyang suṃ la sogs pa bzlas na mthu dang ldan par 'gyur ro zhes bla ma dam pa rnams gsung / rje btsun rtse mos gsungs pa bzhin bde bas/ deng sang gi nyams len 'di la mdzad/ rje btsun grags pa dang 'phags pa rin po che'i gsungs bzhin byas na yang shin du legs so/ /bzlas tshul ni gur las/ bsam gtan ldan pas sngags bzlas bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don/ bkod pa'i bzlas pa spro bsdu'i bzlas pa 'khor ba'i bzlas pa rnams las/ 'dir 'khor ba'i bzlas pa byed pas byed lugs ni/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las rtsa sngags la sogs pa chu bur rdol ba'i tshul gyi zhi ba la 'od zer dkar po/ rgyas pa la ser po/ dbang la dmar po/ drag po la 'od zer nag po 'phros pas/ 'od zer dkar pos sdig sgrib thams cad zhi bar byed/ ser pos yon tan thams cad rgyas par byed/ dmar pos 'gro ba thams cad dbang du sdud/

nag pos gdon bgegs log 'dren nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad tshar bcad par bsam la/ sngags rnams zhi ba la gcig rting gcig 'gro ba bar ma chad par ra zam pa la 'gro ba lta bu/ rgyas pa la sngags gcig la gcig dgongs te bsgro'i chun po lta bu 'gro ba dang / dbang la gcig gi gsham la gcig gi mgo lcags kyu ltar rgyab te lcags sgrog bzhin 'gro ba dang / drag po la sngags gcig la gcig sgril te srad bu ltar 'gro ba rnams yab kyi zhal nas thon/ yum gyi zhal du zhugs sku'i dbyibs brgyud padma nas thon/ yab kyi rdo rje nas zhugs/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim pas phar 'khor ram yum gyi aṃ las sngags thon/ yum gyi zhal nas yab kyi zhal du zhugs pa sogs tshur 'khor gang bde bya/ 'khor rnams la yang rang rang gi sngags gong bzhin yab yum gnyis la 'khor ba'i sbyor mtshams nas 'od zer 'phros te sngags gang bzlas pa'i 'khor de la phog pas dbang du 'dus par bsam zhing bzla/ de'i rjes su mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad 'dus par bsgom pa dang / lha rnams kyi spyi bor rigs bdag rnams gsal btab ste zhwa phud/ thal mo sbyar te ngag tu bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyis sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi rgyud byin rlabs tu gsol zhing mchog gi dngos grub myur du thob po byin gyis brlab du gsol/ de'i thabs su bdag gi rgyud la byang chub kyi sems rin po che gnyis dang rim pa gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin dang rtogs pa bzang po khyad par can skyes la gnas pa gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par byin gyi brlab du gsol/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod/ ting nge 'dzin dang rtogs pa brtan par bsam/ thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros dkyil 'khor bsdu/ rdo rje'i glu blang pa/ shis pa brjod pa/ smon lam btab pa/ go cha bkod de spyod lam la 'jug pa rnams mngon rtogs bzhin no/

/bzlas pa'i sbyang gzhi ni tha mal pa'i gang zag de 'byung ba'i rtsa yig de'i steng na yod pa'i sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa rnams ngo bo bde stong gi ye shes tshangs pa'i dbyangs/ rnam pa rtsa sngags snying po sogs lha de dang de'i sngags su bsgyur nas bzla/ phan yon ni/ gur las/ mkha' 'gro ma dang rang btsun mo/ /mngon sum du ni bya ba'i phyir/ /sngags ni bod pa zhes bshad la/ /de nyid bskul bar smra ba'o/ /sngags ni snyan gsan 'bebs par brjod/ /dper na skyes bu la la zhig /skad kyi nga ros bos pa na/ /mngon sum du ni 'ong bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin de ni gshegs kun gshegs/ /zhes sogs pa'i don yin/ gzhan bzlas pa'i grangs dang / go rim dang / bzlas pa'i yul/ phreng ba'i rnam par bzhag pa la sogs pa rnams rgyas par 'dod na snying po don gsal du shes par bya'o// ༈ //gnyis pa gtor ma 'bul tshul ni/ bgegs dang log par 'dren pa las/ /sems can rnams kyi srog bsrungs phyir/ /rdo rje sems dpas gtor ma bstan/ /zhes dang / gur las/ nam mkha'i khams kyi dbus gnas pa/ /padma 'dab brgyad bsgom par bya/ /zhes pas mgron gyi gnas/ oṃ las tshangs pa la sogs lha/ /hūm̐ las ma chags pa la sogs/ /a las stobs kyi rgyu la sogs/ /lag gnyis gdong dang ldan rnams ste/ /steng gi lha rnams dkar po che/ /dbang po la sogs nag po mtshungs/ /stobs kyi rgyu sogs dmar po che/ /rang mtshungs rig mas lus spras nas/ /rdo rje dril bu'i lag gnyis sbrel/ /g.yas brkyang pas ni gdan la gnas/ /zhes pa la sogs pa rgyas par bstan pa'i don/ bse lcags la sogs pa'i snod ma yin par thod pa'am li zangs la sogs pa'i snod du nas 'bras la sogs pa'i zan la rdo rje chu'i dam tshig gi gzungs las/ nas kyi zan la gtor ma padma'i dbyibs can byas la ces gsungs pa dang mthun par/ snying po zlum zhing rtse mo ha cang mi rno ba pad 'dab lta bu mtheb dkyus bskor ba lnga tshar sogs bshams/

nang mchod chu chang gi sbyangs/ de'i mdun du chu bzhi nyer spyod lnga bsham/ bdag bskyed rgyas bsdus gang rung sngon du song nas/ dang po mchod pa byin gyis rlabs/ de nas gtor ma du yod kyang dus gcig la byin gyis rlabs pa mngon rtogs bzhin bya/ mgron gyi ting nge 'dzin ni mdun bskyed dang ma 'brel zhing / dus rgyun ma'i gtor 'bul lha dang 'byung po tha mi dad du bya tshul la/ gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkhar chos 'byung gru gsum gsum brtseg gi nang rnams su padma 'dab brgyad re re/ steng gi padma'i lte bar sku rdo rje/ 'dab ma brgyad la lha dgu/ bar gyi padma'i lte bar dpal kyai rdo rje lha dgu/ 'dab ma brgyad la phyogs skyong brgyad/ 'og gi padma'i lte ba la gsung rdo rje/ 'dab ma brgyad la klu brgyad bskyed pa mngon rtogs bzhin gsal btab/ rang gi thugs kha nas 'od 'phros/ steng gi lha thams cad lha chen brgyad la bsdu/ sa steng gi sems can thams cad phyogs skyong brgyad la bsdu/ sa 'og gi sems can thams cad klu chen brgyad la bsdu/ de dag byin gyis rlabs pa'i phyir ye shes pa 'jug dbang bskur rigs bdag gi rgyas btab/ chu bzhi phul te mgron gsal btab pa dang / 'bul sngags rnams 'brel te gsum mam lnga'i gtor ma 'bul/ me tog sogs kyi mchod/ nang mchod 'bul/ dkar mo ri dwags kyis mchod/ khyod ni rnal 'byor mas lha dgu la bstod/ mi bskyod rdo rje sogs kyi gzhan rnams la bstod/ lha chen brgyad po sogs kyi 'phrin las bcol/ de nas 'khor lo bde mchog sogs yi dam rnams dang / gur gyi mgon po sogs bsrung ma gang byed rnams dang mkha' 'gro spyi gtor yan phul te rang 'od dpag med kyai rdo rjer bsgom la/ rdo rje'i glu blangs pas gtor mgron rnams mnyes te me tog gi char phab bkra shis kyi mnga' gsol te bdag rgyud la spang pa dang rtogs pa'i yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du rgyas par bsam zhing gtor mgron rnams mngon sum du bzhugs pa la smon lam gyi dpang po zhus te/

rtsa rgyud las/ rigs su skyes dang dam tshig can/ /zhes tshigs bcad gnyis gsungs te/ de'i don sa skya pa chen pos/ bum dbang la sbyar ba ni/ zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa'i rigs su skye dang / dam tshig can ni bza' dang bsrung ba ni dam tshig ldan pa/ smyo med ni tha mal gyi rnam par rtog pas ma smyo ste der ma shor ba'o/ /bum pa'i dbang bskur ba'i bla ma la gus la/ sems can la snying rje dang ldan pa'o/ /phyi ma dang yang phyi ma la sogs par skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog gcig pa'o/ /lag pas rdo rje dril bu 'khrol ba ni rdo rje dang dril bu dang mi 'bral bar byed pa'o/ /zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang ni dges pa'i rdo rje la sogs pa'i zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang nyan pa dang 'dzin pa'o/ /btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam zas can ni/ bdud rtsi lnga la longs spyod pa'o/ /phyi ma dang yang phyi ma la sogs par skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar de ltar shog ces pa'o/ /gsang ba'i dbang dang sbyar na/ gsang ba'i dbang gi rigs su skye dang dam tshig can ste/ thun bcag pa dang / thun tshod yol ba dang / rnam rtog rkun bu las bsrung ba'o/ /smyo med ni bsam gtan gyi sgrib pa dang bral bas te ma smyo ba'o/ /kyai rdo rje rang 'byung gi ye shes ston pa'i gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba'i bla ma la gus pa skye zhing sogs ni sngar dang 'dra'o/ /lag pa rdo rje dril bu khrol ba ni/ rtsa g.yas g.yon dbu mar 'dzud pa dang mi 'bral ba'o/ /zab mo'i chos klog pa ni dril can gyi sgra/ btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam zas ni khams dgu 'dus pa'o/ /dbang gsum pa dang sbyar na/ dbang gsum pa'i rigs su skye dang / thig le la gnod pa'i zas spyod rnams spong ba'i dam tshig can dbang gsum pa'i nyams myong dang ma bral bas smyo med kyai rdo rje lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ston pa dbang gsum pa bskur ba'i bla ma la gus pas so/ /lag pa rdo rje dril bu 'khrol ba ni rdo rje dang padma sbyor ba dang mi 'bral bar byed pa/

zab mo'i chos klog pa ni bde ba'i nyams dang mi 'bral bar byed pa/ btsun mo'i khu ba ni phyag rgya chen po'i brten pa'i nyams dang mi 'bral bar byed pa'o/ /dbang bzhi pa dang sbyar na/ dbang bzhi'i rigs su skye dang 'dzag pa bsrung ba'i dam tshig can/ sgrib pa gnyis dang bral bas smyo med kyai rdo rje shin du rnam par dag pa'i ye shes ston pa dbang bzhi pa ston pa'i bla ma la gus pa'o/ /lag pa rdo rje dril bu 'khrol ba ni phyag rgya padma can dang rdo rje dang padma kha sbyor ba dang mi 'bral bar byed pa/ zab mo'i chos klog pa ni bde ba'i nyams dang mi 'bral bar byed pa/ btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam zas ni phyag rgya padma can gyi thig le brten par byed pa dang mi 'bral bar byed pa'o/ /zhes so/ /de nas saṃ ṭi las gsungs pa'i sems can thams cad sogs kyi sems can thams cad kyi gnas skabs mthar thug gi bde ba thob par smon lam btab pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni yig brgya lan gsum gyi lhag chad kha bskang / ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyi bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzad sogs kyi mjug tu 'bru gsum dang / badzra muḥbarjod cing phyag rgya bcas pas gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa rang la bsdus la mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma sogs go cha bsgo ste nga rgyal bzung ngo / /gtor ma'i dgos pa ni bgegs dang log 'dren gyi bar chad sel ba dang nad zhi ba dang tshe dang longs spyod 'phel ba'i dgos pa yod/ rtsa rgyud las/ gal te 'di'i 'byung po thams cad mchod par byed na zhes pa nas/ zhi ba dang rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi phan yon che ba bstan te/ gsum pa kha zas kyi rnal 'byor la rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum las/ rgyas par gzhan du gsal/ 'bring po ni mdun du legs par bshams pa'i kha zas/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil du oṃ bsam la de bstan te/ oṃ zhes brjod de de las 'od zer 'phros kha zas la phog pas stong par sbyangs/

g.yas pa'i mthil du aḥbasam la de bstan te āḥzhes brjod pas/ de las 'od 'phros mdun du thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba dpral ba rang la bstan pa gcig byung bar bsam/ gnyis ka'i mthil du hūm̐ bsam la gnyis ka bstan te/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas de las 'od zer byung bas thod pa'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga byung bar bsam/ bya khyung gi phyag rgya bstan la/ hoḥzhes brjod pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur par bsam la 'bru gsum lan gsum brjod pas byin gyi brlab te rang gi snying khar lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor bsam/ lte ba nas me 'bar te lha mchod pa'i bsam pas bza'o/ /gsum pa ni kha zas la lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin sbyar ba reg te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pas kha zas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga'i ngo bor bsam/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ de lha thams cad kyi ngo bor bsam la de mchod pa'i bsam pas bzos pas hūm̐ de gzi brjid 'bar bar bsam ste snying rje'i sa bon me sbar la/ de'i ga bur btung bar bsam/ btung ba de yi rnal 'byor pa/ /myur du dngos sgrub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas lha mchod par 'gyur ba dang / phan yon yongs su sbyong ba dang / bu lon du mi 'gyur ba dang / bcud len du 'gyur ba dang / rtsa ltung bcu gsum pa mi 'byung ba'i dgos pa yod do// ༈ //bzhi pa ni rab 'byung rnams la mi dgos kyang / khyim pa rdo rje 'dzin pas las kyi phyag rgya bsten pa yin na bdag dang phyag rgya kyai rdo rje yab yum du bskyed pa lha'i 'du shes/ mkha' gsang sgo gsum byin rlabs pa sngags kyi 'du shes/ bde chen gyi ye shes kyi kyai rdo rje mchod par bya'o snyam pa dang lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du bya'o snyam pa chos kyi 'du shes/ de ltar sbyang gzhi tha mal gyi 'du shes de sbyong byed 'du shes gsum ldan gyi rdo rje'i chags par bsgyur nas bsgom la/

de'i dgos pa yang 'dod pas log par g.yem par mi 'gyur ba dang lha mchod par 'gyur ba dang / lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes myur du skye ba'i dgos pa yod// ༈ //lnga pa rang bzhin lhan skyes stong pa'i ngang la nyal ba dang zhu bde lhan skyed bde ba'i ngang la nyal ba gnyis/ dang po ni srod thun gyi rim pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i mjug gong dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'am/ ma bsdus na snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros snod bcud la phog pas de bsrung 'khor la bsdu/ de dur khrod brgyad la/ de gzhal yas khang la/ de lha mo brgyad la/ de zhal brgyad la/ yum yang yab la/ de snying kha'i hūm̐ la/ de'i zhabs kyu khog pa la/ de yang mgo bo la/ de zla tshes la/ de thig le la/ de nā da la/ nā da yang dmigs pa'i ngang la nyal lo/ /gnyis pa ni snod bcud bsrung 'khor la bsdu/ de mi bsdu bar bzhag gzhal yas khang bsdu'am ma bsdus kyang rung ste/ lha mo brgyad zhal brgyad la bsdu/ gtso bo yab yum tsam du gnas pa de dag thabs shes snyoms par zhugs pas rjes su chags pa'i mes phung po khams skye mched thams cad 'od du zhu nas byang chub kyi sems kyi ngo bo bde stong zung 'jug thig le'i rnam par gyur pa la blo gtad de nyal lo/ /de yang las dang pos/ dang po ltar nyal la sems cung zad brtan nas stong shas che na bde ba/ bde shas che na stong pa'i ngang la nyal lo/ /sbyang gzhi tha mal pa'i gnyid sogs sbyong byed rnal 'byor de'i dngos por sgyur nas nyal lo// ༈ //drug pa nyal lugs kyi bye brag gi ldang lugs gnyis su 'gyur te/ nub mo stong nyid kyi ngang la nyal na/ tho rangs skad cig gi kyai rdo rje yab yum kyi skur langs la/ zhu bde'i ngang la nyal na gnyid sad pa dang mtshams kyi lha mo bzhi rang bzhin gyi gnas nas byon nas/ rje btsun sogs kyi glus bskul bas thig le 'bras bu rdo rje 'chang yab yum du bzhengs pa ltar langs la/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo 'phrod pa'i sgo nas rnal 'byor nyams su blang bar bya'o//
