༈ //bdun pa khrus kyi rnal 'byor ni/ bsam gtan gyi grogs su 'gro na tho rangs sam gnas skabs gzhan du khrus byed pa'i tshe/ dbang lha spyan drangs te de la mchod bstod gsol btab rnams dbang gi skabs ltar byas pas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams he ru ka'i gzugs kyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pas spyi bor nas dbang bskur/ rig ma rnams kyi rdo rje'i glu blangs/ sems dpa' rnams kyi bkra shis brjod/ khro bo rnams kyi bgegs bskrad par bsam la/ lus kyis khrus byas ngag tu yig brgya bzlas pas sdig sgrib thams cad dag par bsam/ dgos pa ni bsam gtan gyi grogs su 'gyur ba dang nyin zhag gcig gi rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa dag par 'gyur ro// ༈ //brgyad pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ langs te lha'i gzugs su bzhag /ces gsungs pa ltar mnyam gzhag las langs te spyod lam la 'jug pa'i tshe snang stong dbyer med sgyu ma lta bu dpal kyai rdo rjer snang ba thams cad shes par byas nas spyad de/ rang gi lhag pa'i lha sbyor bas/ /bdag dang gzhan la mchod par gyis/ /zhes gsungs so/ /lha so so'i thabs la mkhas pa ni kun rdzob kyi snang ba 'di yul yul can gyi dbye ba mtha' yas par shes par bya ste/ de re re yang lha so sor bsgom par byas te/ gzugs gau rī/ sgra tsau rī/ dri baitta lī/ ro ghasma rī/ reg sa spyod ma/ chos khams mkha' spyod ma sogs su bsgom par bya'o/ /spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor 'di rnams kyi sbyang gzhi tha mal du snod bcud ma dag pa'i snang ba 'di thams cad dag pa lha'i dkyil 'khor du bsgom pa'i ngang nas chos 'chad nyan sogs chos mthun gyi bya ba rnams byas pas mchog gi dngos sgrub myur du thob bo/ /de lta bu'i dgos pa ni tha mal gyi rnam rtog bzlog pa dang / bar chad kyis mi tshugs pa dang / lhas lha la mchod par 'gyur ba dang / rtsa ltung brgyad pa mi 'byung ba'o/

/de ltar rnal 'byor bcu nyams su blangs pas rim pa gnyis la brten pa'i drod chung ngu thob pa dang kun 'dar gsang ste spyod/ de la brten nas drod 'bring po thob pa'i tshe kun 'dar 'jig rten pas mngon du spyod/ de la brten nas drod chen po thob pa dang / kun du bzang po'i spyod pa spyad pas/ sa lam rnams rim gyis bsgrod/ nye rgyu'i mtshams sbyar bas zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob pa yin no/ /gnas skabs 'bras bu sa bcu gnyis pa'i thun mong ba'i ming ni/ a bhi dha na las/ 'od byed pa dang 'od 'phro can/ /sbyang du dka' ba mngon du 'gyur/ /ring du song dang mi g.yo ba/ /legs pa'i blo gros chos kyi sprin/ /dpe med pa dang ye shes che/ /zhes sogs la/ thun mong ma yin pa'i ming ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ gnas dang nye ba'i gnas dang ni/ /zhing dang nye ba'i zhing nyid dang / /tshan dho nye ba'i tshan dho dang / /de bzhin 'du ba nye 'du ba/ /dur khrod nye ba'i dur khrod nyid/ /'thung gcod nye ba'i 'thung gcod nyid/ /'di rnams sa ni bcu gnyis te/ /zhes sogs/ /ming gnyis don gcig par bstan pa ni/ saṃ ṭi las/ gnas ni rab tu dga' ba'i sa/ /de bzhin nyer gnas dri ma med/ /zhing ni 'od byed shes par bya/ /nye ba'i zhing ni 'od 'phro can/ /tshan dho mngon du gyur pa ste/ /nye ba'i tshan dho sbyangs dka' ba/ /'du ba ring du song ba ste/ /nye ba'i 'du ba mi g.yo ba/ /dur khrod legs pa'i blo gros te/ /nye ba'i dur khrod chos kyi sprin/ /pha rol phyin bcu'i sa rnams la/ /rnal 'byor pa yis kla klo'i skad/ /ces dang / rgyud rgyas pa las/ 'thung gcod dpe med ye shes te/ /nye ba'i 'thung gcod ye shes che/ /zhes so/ /mthar thug sa bcu gsum pa ni/ rdo rje 'dzin pa bcu gsum pa/ /zhes dang / dgongs pa lung ston las/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi gang brten pa'i/ /sa gyur de ni bcu gsum pa/ /zhees gsungs pa rnams kyi lam bsgrod tshul bstan pa yin no/

/'bras bu sangs rgyas ni sku ye shes dang 'phrin las dang nus mthu dang yon tan bsam gyi mi khyab pa dang ldan pa yin no/ /de rnams ni mngon rtogs yan lag drug pa lam dus dang bcas pa'i sgom don bla ma'i gsung bzhin gsal bar bstan pa yin no// ༈ //dbang chu rgyun gcig pa'i bsgom don ni/ dbang lha spyan drangs pa/ lha mo brgyad kyi mchod pa/ zhe sdang rdo rje sogs kyis bstod pa/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /sogs kyis gsol ba btab pa sogs gong bzhin bya/ dbang len pa po ni/ ye shes dang gnyis su med pa'i lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi len/ bskur bar bya ba'i dbang ni grub chen mtsho skyes kyi gsung dang thun par dbang bzhi chu rgyun gcig la len te/ de'i sbyang gzhi ni dus skad cig ma bzhi la sbyang gzhi'i lus ngag yid gsum ka dang / gnas brtan pa dang thams cad yod par smra ba dang kun gyis bkur ba dang dge 'dun phal cher bzhi dang skye rga na 'chi'i chu bo chen po bzhi rnams sbyong byed slob dpon dang / gsang dbang dang shes rab ye shes dang dbang bzhi pa bskur bas sbyangs 'bras dga' ba dang mchog dga' dang dga' bral gyi dga' ba dang lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba bzhi thob/ dbang skur tshul ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi dbang bskur/ rig ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa phul bas dbang gi chu rgyun gyis smin mtshams yan chad gang / bum pa'i dbang thob lus kyi dri ma sogs pa rnams dag lam bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang bas bskyed rim lha'i sku la dag pa sbyar ba ni spyi bo'i 'khor lo mi bskyod pa sogs brjod/ dbang gi chu rgyun gyi mgrin pa yan chad gang / gsang ba'i dbang thob ngag gi dri ma la sogs pa rnams dag mthar thug gtum mo'i dmigs pa thams cad kyi gtso bo 'khor lo bzhi'i yang rtsa ba'i snying po lta bu gsal btab ste lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo aṃ las kyi phyag rgya/

snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo hūm̐ chos kyi phyag rgya/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo oṃ phyag rgya chen po/ spyi bo bde chen kyi 'khor lo haṃ dam tshig gi phyag rgya rnams brjod/ bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa sgom pa la dbang bas de'i mthar thug 'khor lo bzhi'i rgyas btab pa 'brel pas dran par bya ba yin/ yang dbang gi chu rgyun gyi snying kha yan gang / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob yid kyi dri ma la sogs pa rnams dag dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bsgom pa la dbang / des dbang po drug yul drug lhug par bzhag pa la dbang bas skye mched sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis rlabs pa dran par bya/ yang chu rgyun gyi rkang mthil yan mer gyi gang / mchog tu bde ba chen po dbang bzhi pa thob sgo gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag lam rdo rje rba rlabs sgom pa la dbang / des dbang bzhi rdzogs pa yin pas dbang lha bstim la rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab pa gong bzhin bya'o/ /bskyed rim yan lag drug lam dus dang bcas pa'i sgom don gyi rim pa rnams 'di'i phyogs la thugs dam mdzad pa'i gang zag rnams la phan pa'i ched du shākya'i dge slong dpal ldan bkra shis kyis gsal bar bris pa'o// ༈ //lam dus kyi dbang lha spyan 'dren gyi skabs su gzhal yas khang rnams zlum po sum rim gyi rnam pa can la/ dbus la/ dbus su rang la rgyu dus kyi dbang bskur ba'i bla ma mi bskyod pa kyai rdo rje yab yum/ shar du rnam snang / lhor rin chen 'byung ldan/ nub tu 'od dpag med/ byang du don yod grub pa/ kyai rdo rje thams cad yum dang bcas pa phyag bcu drug gi bum pa 'dzin pa/ mtshams bzhir byang shar nas spyan ma/ mā ma ki gos dkar mo/ sgrol ma rnams 'khod/ rim pa gnyis pa la byang sems brgyad/ rim pa gsum pa la lha mo drug khro bo bcu 'khod par bsam la de dag gi drung du len/ /i+-itsha/ bkra shis//
